    function getTextureMetrics(root) {
      const textures = new Set();
      const slots = ['map', 'normalMap', 'roughnessMap', 'metalnessMap', 'emissiveMap', 'aoMap'];
      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;
        const list = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : object.material ? [object.material] : [];
        for (const material of list) for (const slot of slots) {
          if (material?.[slot]?.isTexture) textures.add(material[slot]);
        }
      });
      let maxTextureEdge = 0;
      for (const texture of textures) {
        const image = texture.source?.data || texture.image;
        maxTextureEdge = Math.max(maxTextureEdge, Number(image?.width || 0), Number(image?.height || 0));
      }
      return { textures, maxTextureEdge };
    }
    
    export function inspectCC0OfficeLobby(gltf, THREE) {
      const root = gltf?.scene;
      if (!root) throw new Error('Lobby GLB has no default scene.');
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const bounds = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root);
      const size = bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      const materials = new Set();
      let meshes = 0;
      let triangles = 0;
      let vertices = 0;
      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;
        meshes += 1;
        const positions = object.geometry?.getAttribute?.('position');
        const count = object.geometry?.index?.count ?? positions?.count ?? 0;
        const instanceFactor = object.isInstancedMesh ? Math.max(1, object.count) : 1;
        triangles += Math.floor(count / 3) * instanceFactor;
        vertices += (positions?.count || 0) * instanceFactor;
        const list = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : object.material ? [object.material] : [];
        for (const material of list) materials.add(material);
      });
      const textureMetrics = getTextureMetrics(root);
      return {
        bounds,
        size: { x: size.x, y: size.y, z: size.z },
        meshes,
        triangles,
        vertices,
        materials: materials.size,
        textures: textureMetrics.textures.size,
        maxTextureEdge: textureMetrics.maxTextureEdge
      };
    }
    
    function geometryAttributeSignature(geometry) {
      return Object.entries(geometry.attributes)
        .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .map(([name, attribute]) => `${name}:${attribute.itemSize}:${attribute.normalized ? 1 : 0}:${attribute.array?.constructor?.name || 'unknown'}`)
        .join('|');
    }
    
    function disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets) {
      for (const materialBuckets of buckets.values()) {
        for (const bySignature of [materialBuckets.standard, materialBuckets.decorative]) {
          for (const geometries of bySignature.values()) {
            for (const geometry of geometries) geometry.dispose();

        }
      }
    }
    
    function hasLobbyDecorativeAncestor(object) {

      }

    /**
     * Batch the static source meshes by shared material and matching attributes.
     * If any mesh cannot safely be merged, preserve the complete authored scene.
     */
    export function createCC0OfficeLobbyRenderRoot(gltf, THREE) {
      const sourceRoot = gltf.scene;
      sourceRoot.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const buckets = new Map();
      let sourceMeshes = 0;
      let unsupportedMeshes = 0;
    
      sourceRoot.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;
        sourceMeshes += 1;
        if (
          !object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh
          || Array.isArray(object.material) || object.morphTargetInfluences?.length
          || !object.geometry || !object.material
        ) {
          unsupportedMeshes += 1;
          return;
        }
        const geometry = object.geometry.clone();
        geometry.applyMatrix4(object.matrixWorld);
        const signature = geometryAttributeSignature(geometry);
        let materialBuckets = buckets.get(object.material);
        if (!materialBuckets) {
          materialBuckets = { standard: new Map(), decorative: new Map() };
          buckets.set(object.material, materialBuckets);
        }
        // Keep authored foliage in separate batches so it can cast real shadows;
        // the larger static lobby remains aggressively batched for performance.
        const bySignature = hasLobbyDecorativeAncestor(object)
          ? materialBuckets.decorative
          : materialBuckets.standard;
        const geometries = bySignature.get(signature) || [];
        geometries.push(geometry);
        bySignature.set(signature, geometries);
      });
    
      if (unsupportedMeshes || !buckets.size) {
        disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets);
        return {
          root: sourceRoot.clone(true), merged: false, drawCalls: sourceMeshes,
          mergeReason: unsupportedMeshes ? 'source includes unsupported mesh types or material layouts' : 'no mergeable meshes'
        };
      }
    
      const mergedRoot = new THREE.Group();
      mergedRoot.name = 'calloria-cc0-office-lobby-batches';
      const generatedGeometries = [];
      let drawCalls = 0;
      try {
        for (const [material, materialBuckets] of buckets) {
          for (const [layer, bySignature] of Object.entries(materialBuckets)) {
            const decorative = layer === 'decorative';
            for (const [signature, geometries] of bySignature) {
              const merged = geometries.length === 1 ? geometries[0] : mergeGeometries(geometries, false);
              if (!merged) throw new Error(`Could not merge lobby vertex attributes: ${signature}`);
              if (geometries.length > 1) for (const geometry of geometries) geometry.dispose();
              merged.computeBoundingBox();
              merged.computeBoundingSphere();
              const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(merged, material);
              mesh.name = `${decorative ? 'calloria-lobby-decor' : 'calloria-lobby'}-batch-${drawCalls + 1}`;
              mesh.userData.calloriaLobbyDecorative = decorative;
              mesh.castShadow = decorative;
              mesh.receiveShadow = false;
              mesh.frustumCulled = true;
              mergedRoot.add(mesh);
              generatedGeometries.push(merged);
              drawCalls += 1;
            }
          }
        }
        const decorativeBatches = [...mergedRoot.children].filter((object) => object.userData?.calloriaLobbyDecorative).length;
        return { root: mergedRoot, merged: true, drawCalls, decorativeBatches, generatedGeometries, mergeReason: null };
      } catch (error) {
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets);
        return {
          root: sourceRoot.clone(true), merged: false, drawCalls: sourceMeshes,
          generatedGeometries: [], mergeReason: String(error?.message || error)
        };
      }
    }
    
    function hideReceptionFallbacks(scene) {
      const changed = [];
      for (const name of CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_FALLBACK_OBJECTS) {
        const object = scene.getObjectByName(name);
        if (!object || !object.visible) continue;
        changed.push({ object, visible: object.visible });
        object.visible = false;
      }
      return changed;
    }
    
    function restoreReceptionFallbacks(changed) {
      for (const entry of changed) entry.object.visible = entry.visible;
    }
    
    export async function integrateCalloriaCC0OfficeLobby({
      THREE,
      scene,
      loader,
      tier = 'balanced',
      isActive = () => true
    } = {}) {
      if (!THREE?.Group || !scene?.add || !scene?.getObjectByName || !loader?.loadAsync) {
        throw new TypeError('CALLORIA reception lobby requires the active Three.js scene and configured GLTFLoader.');
      }
    
      let disposed = false;
      let gltf = null;
      let placedRoot = null;
      let generatedGeometries = [];
      let hiddenFallbacks = [];
      let greeneryLease = null;
      let partitionLease = null;
      let partitionLoad = null;
      const partitionStatus = { loaded: false, attempted: true, reason: 'department glass integration pending' };
      const emitPartitionStatus = () => {
        if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && typeof CustomEvent !== 'undefined') {
          window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('calloria:glazed-partitions-ready', { detail: partitionStatus }));
        }
      };
      const startPartitionIntegration = () => {
        if (partitionLoad) return partitionLoad;
        partitionLoad = integrateCalloriaGlazedDepartmentPartitions(scene, {
          tier,
          isActive: () => !disposed && isActive()
        }).then((lease) => {
          if (disposed || !isActive()) {
            lease?.dispose?.();
            return null;
          }
          partitionLease = lease || null;
          Object.assign(partitionStatus, lease?.status || {
            loaded: false,
            attempted: true,
            reason: 'department glass integration returned no status'
          });
          emitPartitionStatus();
          return partitionLease;
        }).catch((error) => {
          if (disposed || !isActive()) return null;
          Object.assign(partitionStatus, {
            loaded: false,
            attempted: true,
            reason: String(error?.message || error)
          });
          emitPartitionStatus();
          return null;
        });
        return partitionLoad;
      };
      const release = () => {
        if (disposed) return;
        disposed = true;
        partitionLease?.dispose?.();
        partitionLease = null;
        greeneryLease?.dispose?.();
        greeneryLease = null;
        if (placedRoot) scene.remove(placedRoot);
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        restoreReceptionFallbacks(hiddenFallbacks);
        if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
        gltf = null;
        generatedGeometries = [];
        hiddenFallbacks = [];
        placedRoot = null;
      };
    
      try {
        // Start department glass independently of the reception GLB request. This
        // uses the active production scene and waits briefly for its named panes.
        void startPartitionIntegration();
        gltf = await loader.loadAsync(CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.url);
        if (disposed || !isActive()) {
          disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
          gltf = null;
          return {
            status: { loaded: false, attempted: true, reason: 'world disposed while lobby was loading' },
            update() {}, dispose: release
          };
        }
    
        const metrics = inspectCC0OfficeLobby(gltf, THREE);
        const validation = validateCC0OfficeLobby(metrics);
        if (!validation.valid) throw new Error(validation.errors.join('; '));
    
        // Populate only planter anchors authored in the lobby GLB. The integration
        // returns a no-op lease when no safe, named anchors are present.
        greeneryLease = await addCalloriaLobbyGreenery(gltf, { isActive: () => !disposed && isActive() });
        if (disposed || !isActive()) {
          greeneryLease?.dispose?.();
          greeneryLease = null;
          if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
          gltf = null;
          return {
            status: { loaded: false, attempted: true, reason: 'world disposed during lobby greenery integration' },
            update() {}, dispose: release
          };
        }
    
        const rendered = createCC0OfficeLobbyRenderRoot(gltf, THREE);
        const lighting = applyCalloriaLobbyLightingPolicy(rendered.root, { tier });
        placedRoot = new THREE.Group();
        placedRoot.name = 'calloria-cc0-office-lobby';
        placedRoot.scale.setScalar(CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.placedScale);
        placedRoot.position.set(
          CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.position.x,
          CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.position.y,
          CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.position.z
        );
        const center = metrics.bounds.getCenter(new THREE.Vector3());
        rendered.root.position.add(new THREE.Vector3(-center.x, -metrics.bounds.min.y, -center.z));
        rendered.root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        placedRoot.add(rendered.root);
    
        // The replacement must be in the scene before any existing reception mesh
        // is hidden. This order guarantees a visible fallback on all failure paths.
        generatedGeometries = rendered.generatedGeometries || [];
        scene.add(placedRoot);
        hiddenFallbacks = hideReceptionFallbacks(scene);
    
        const status = Object.freeze({
          loaded: true,
          attempted: true,
          id: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id,
          name: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.name,
          url: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.url,
          sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.sourceUrl,
          license: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.license,
          licenseUrl: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.licenseUrl,
          triangles: metrics.triangles,
          meshes: metrics.meshes,
          vertices: metrics.vertices,
          materials: metrics.materials,
          textures: metrics.textures,
          maxTextureEdge: metrics.maxTextureEdge,
          merged: rendered.merged,
          drawCalls: rendered.drawCalls,
          mergeReason: rendered.mergeReason,
          decorativeBatches: rendered.decorativeBatches || 0,
          lighting,
          fallbacksHidden: hiddenFallbacks.length,
          greenery: greeneryLease?.status || { loaded: false, reason: 'greenery integration returned no status' },
          partitions: partitionStatus,
          tier,
          scale: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.placedScale,
          placement: { ...CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_LIMITS.position }

    function buildChairBatches(gltf, placements) {
      const root = gltf.scene;
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const buckets = new Map();

      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;

        }
        return { root: mergedRoot, merged: true, drawCalls, sourceMeshes, generatedGeometries };
      } catch (error) {
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets);
        throw error;
      }
    }
    
    function hideLegacyChairInstances(scene, stationIds) {
      const hidden = [];
      const targetIndexes = stationIds.map((id) => id - 1);
      for (const name of LEGACY_CHAIR_NAMES) {
        const object = scene.getObjectByName(name);
        if (!object?.isInstancedMesh) continue;
        const saved = [];
        const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
        for (const index of targetIndexes) {
          if (index < 0 || index >= object.count) continue;
          object.getMatrixAt(index, matrix);
          saved.push({ index, matrix: matrix.clone() });
          const position = new THREE.Vector3();
          const quaternion = new THREE.Quaternion();
          const scale = new THREE.Vector3();
          matrix.decompose(position, quaternion, scale);
          scale.set(0, 0, 0);
          object.setMatrixAt(index, new THREE.Matrix4().compose(position, quaternion, scale));
        }
        if (saved.length) {
          object.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
          object.computeBoundingSphere?.();
          hidden.push({ object, saved });
        }
      }
      return hidden;
    }
    
    function restoreLegacyChairInstances(hidden) {
      for (const { object, saved } of hidden) {
        for (const entry of saved) object.setMatrixAt(entry.index, entry.matrix);
        object.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
        object.computeBoundingSphere?.();
      }
    }
    
    function inactiveResult(reason, tier, extra = {}) {
      return {
        status: { loaded: false, attempted: false, chairsPlaced: 0, tier, reason, ...extra },
        update() {},
        dispose() {}
      };
    }
    
    export async function integrateCalloriaCC0OfficeChairs({ scene, stations, tier = 'balanced', isActive = () => true } = {}) {
      if (!scene?.add || !scene?.getObjectByName) {
        throw new TypeError('CALLORIA CC0 chair integration requires the active Three.js scene.');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(stations) || stations.length === 0) {
        return inactiveResult('Station list unavailable; original chairs retained.', tier);
      }
    
      const stationIds = getCC0ChairStationIds(tier, stations);
      const stationById = new Map(stations.map((station, index) => [
        Number.isFinite(Number(station?.id)) ? Number(station.id) : index + 1,
        station
      ]));
      const placements = stationIds.map((id) => {
        const station = stationById.get(id);
        return station && Number.isFinite(Number(station.x)) && Number.isFinite(Number(station.z))
          ? { id, x: Number(station.x), z: Number(station.z) }
          : null;
      }).filter(Boolean);
    
      if (!placements.length) return inactiveResult('No workstation rows matched this graphics tier; original chairs retained.', tier);
      if (!isCC0ChairPlacementWithinBudget(CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.expected.triangles, placements.length)) {
        return inactiveResult('Placed-chair triangle budget exceeded; original chairs retained.', tier, { attempted: true });
      }
    
      const loader = new GLTFLoader();
      loader.setCrossOrigin('anonymous');
      let disposed = false;
      let gltf = null;
      let placedRoot = null;
      let generatedGeometries = [];
      let hiddenLegacy = [];
    
      try {
        gltf = await loader.loadAsync(CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url);
        if (disposed || !isActive()) {
          disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
          gltf = null;
          return inactiveResult('World disposed during chair model loading; original chairs retained.', tier, { attempted: true });
        }
    
        const metrics = inspectCC0OfficeChair(gltf);
        const validation = validateCC0OfficeChair(metrics);
        if (!validation.valid) throw new Error(validation.errors.join('; '));
        const placedTriangles = getCC0ChairPlacedTriangleCount(metrics.triangles, placements.length);
        if (placedTriangles > CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_LIMITS.maxPlacedTriangles) throw new Error('Placed-chair triangle budget exceeded.');
    
        const render = buildChairBatches(gltf, placements);
        placedRoot = render.root;
        scene.add(placedRoot);
        generatedGeometries = render.generatedGeometries;
        hiddenLegacy = hideLegacyChairInstances(scene, placements.map((placement) => placement.id));
    
        return {
          status: {
            loaded: true,
            attempted: true,
            source: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.name,
            sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.source,
            assetUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url,
            assetId: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.id,
            license: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.license,
            licenseUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.licenseUrl,
            tier,
            stationIds: placements.map((placement) => placement.id),
            chairsPlaced: placements.length,
            trianglesPerChair: metrics.triangles,
            placedTriangles,
            sourceMeshes: metrics.meshes,
            sourceMaterials: metrics.materials,
            textures: metrics.textures,
            mergedDrawCalls: render.drawCalls,
            merged: render.merged,
            dimensionsMeters: metrics.size,
            floorOrigin: metrics.minY,
            fallbackInstancesHidden: hiddenLegacy.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.saved.length, 0)
          },
          update() {},
          dispose() {
            if (disposed) return;
            disposed = true;
            if (placedRoot) scene.remove(placedRoot);
            for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
            restoreLegacyChairInstances(hiddenLegacy);
            if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            generatedGeometries = [];
            hiddenLegacy = [];
            placedRoot = null;
            gltf = null;
          }
        };
      } catch (error) {
        if (placedRoot) scene.remove(placedRoot);
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        restoreLegacyChairInstances(hiddenLegacy);
        if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
        const message = String(error?.message || error);
        return {
          status: {
            loaded: false,
            attempted: true,
            assetId: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.id,
            source: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.name,
            sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.source,
            assetUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url,
            license: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.license,
            tier,
            chairsPlaced: 0,
            reason: message,
            errorCategory: /HTTP|fetch|network|CORS/i.test(message) ? 'http-or-network'
              : /mesh|material|texture|triangle|dimension|geometry|origin|floor/i.test(message) ? 'validation-or-geometry'
                : 'load-or-placement'
          },
          update() {},
          dispose() { disposed = true; }
        };
      }
    }

        meshes,
        triangles,
        materials: materials.size,
        textures: textures.size,
        maxTextureEdge,
        unsupportedMeshes
      };
    }
    
    function attributeSignature(geometry) {
      return Object.entries(geometry.attributes)
        .sort(([a], [b]) => a.localeCompare(b))
        .map(([name, attribute]) => `${name}:${attribute.itemSize}:${attribute.normalized ? 1 : 0}:${attribute.array?.constructor?.name || 'unknown'}`)
        .join('|');
    }
    
    function disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets) {
      for (const bySignature of buckets.values()) {
        for (const geometries of bySignature.values()) {
          for (const geometry of geometries) geometry.dispose();
        }
      }
    }
    
    function buildChairBatches(gltf, placements) {
      const root = gltf.scene;
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const buckets = new Map();
      let sourceMeshes = 0;
      let unsupportedMeshes = 0;
    
      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;
        sourceMeshes += 1;
        if (!object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh || Array.isArray(object.material) || object.morphTargetInfluences?.length || !object.geometry || !object.material) {
          unsupportedMeshes += 1;
          return;
        }
    
        const sourceGeometry = object.geometry.clone();
        sourceGeometry.applyMatrix4(object.matrixWorld);
        const signature = attributeSignature(sourceGeometry);
        let bySignature = buckets.get(object.material);
        if (!bySignature) {
          bySignature = new Map();
          buckets.set(object.material, bySignature);
        }
        const geometries = bySignature.get(signature) || [];
    
        for (const placement of placements) {
          const geometry = sourceGeometry.clone();
          const pose = new THREE.Matrix4().compose(
            new THREE.Vector3(placement.x, 0, placement.z + CHAIR_Z_OFFSET),
            new THREE.Quaternion().setFromAxisAngle(new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0), CHAIR_YAW),
            new THREE.Vector3(CHAIR_SCALE, CHAIR_SCALE, CHAIR_SCALE)
          );
          geometry.applyMatrix4(pose);
          geometries.push(geometry);
        }
        sourceGeometry.dispose();
        bySignature.set(signature, geometries);
      });
    
      if (unsupportedMeshes > 0 || !buckets.size) {
        disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets);
        throw new Error(`chair GLB contains ${unsupportedMeshes} mesh(es) that cannot be safely batched`);
      }
    
      const mergedRoot = new THREE.Group();
      mergedRoot.name = 'calloria-cc0-ergonomic-chair-batches';
      const generatedGeometries = [];
      let drawCalls = 0;
      try {
        for (const [material, bySignature] of buckets) {
          for (const [signature, geometries] of bySignature) {
            const merged = geometries.length === 1 ? geometries[0] : mergeGeometries(geometries, false);
            if (!merged) throw new Error(`Could not merge chair geometry attributes: ${signature}`);
            if (geometries.length > 1) for (const geometry of geometries) geometry.dispose();
            merged.computeBoundingBox();
            merged.computeBoundingSphere();
            const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(merged, material);
            mesh.name = `calloria-cc0-chair-batch-${drawCalls + 1}`;
            mesh.castShadow = false;
            mesh.receiveShadow = false;
            mesh.frustumCulled = true;
            mergedRoot.add(mesh);
            generatedGeometries.push(merged);
            drawCalls += 1;
          }
        }
        return { root: mergedRoot, merged: true, drawCalls, sourceMeshes, generatedGeometries };
      } catch (error) {
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        disposeGeometryBuckets(buckets);
        throw error;
      }
    }
    
    function hideLegacyChairInstances(scene, stationIds) {
      const hidden = [];
      const targetIndexes = stationIds.map((id) => id - 1);
      for (const name of LEGACY_CHAIR_NAMES) {
        const object = scene.getObjectByName(name);
        if (!object?.isInstancedMesh) continue;
        const saved = [];
        const matrix = new THREE.Matrix4();
        for (const index of targetIndexes) {
          if (index < 0 || index >= object.count) continue;
          object.getMatrixAt(index, matrix);
          saved.push({ index, matrix: matrix.clone() });
          const position = new THREE.Vector3();
          const quaternion = new THREE.Quaternion();
          const scale = new THREE.Vector3();
          matrix.decompose(position, quaternion, scale);
          scale.set(0, 0, 0);
          object.setMatrixAt(index, new THREE.Matrix4().compose(position, quaternion, scale));
        }
        if (saved.length) {
          object.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
          object.computeBoundingSphere?.();
          hidden.push({ object, saved });
        }
      }
      return hidden;
    }
    
    function restoreLegacyChairInstances(hidden) {
      for (const { object, saved } of hidden) {
        for (const entry of saved) object.setMatrixAt(entry.index, entry.matrix);
        object.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
        object.computeBoundingSphere?.();
      }
    }
    
    function inactiveResult(reason, tier, extra = {}) {
      return {
        status: { loaded: false, attempted: false, chairsPlaced: 0, tier, reason, ...extra },
        update() {},
        dispose() {}
      };
    }
    
    export async function integrateCalloriaCC0OfficeChairs({ scene, stations, tier = 'balanced', isActive = () => true } = {}) {
      if (!scene?.add || !scene?.getObjectByName) {
        throw new TypeError('CALLORIA CC0 chair integration requires the active Three.js scene.');
      }
      if (!Array.isArray(stations) || stations.length === 0) {
        return inactiveResult('Station list unavailable; original chairs retained.', tier);
      }
    
      const stationIds = getCC0ChairStationIds(tier, stations);
      const stationById = new Map(stations.map((station, index) => [
        Number.isFinite(Number(station?.id)) ? Number(station.id) : index + 1,
        station
      ]));
      const placements = stationIds.map((id) => {
        const station = stationById.get(id);
        return station && Number.isFinite(Number(station.x)) && Number.isFinite(Number(station.z))
          ? { id, x: Number(station.x), z: Number(station.z) }
          : null;
      }).filter(Boolean);
    
      if (!placements.length) return inactiveResult('No workstation rows matched this graphics tier; original chairs retained.', tier);
      if (!isCC0ChairPlacementWithinBudget(CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.expected.triangles, placements.length)) {
        return inactiveResult('Placed-chair triangle budget exceeded; original chairs retained.', tier, { attempted: true });
      }
    
      const loader = new GLTFLoader();
      loader.setCrossOrigin('anonymous');
      let disposed = false;
      let gltf = null;
      let placedRoot = null;
      let generatedGeometries = [];
      let hiddenLegacy = [];
    
      try {
        gltf = await loader.loadAsync(CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url);
        if (disposed || !isActive()) {
          disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
          gltf = null;
          return inactiveResult('World disposed during chair model loading; original chairs retained.', tier, { attempted: true });
        }
    
        const metrics = inspectCC0OfficeChair(gltf);
        const validation = validateCC0OfficeChair(metrics);
        if (!validation.valid) throw new Error(validation.errors.join('; '));
        const placedTriangles = getCC0ChairPlacedTriangleCount(metrics.triangles, placements.length);
        if (placedTriangles > CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_LIMITS.maxPlacedTriangles) throw new Error('Placed-chair triangle budget exceeded.');
    
        const render = buildChairBatches(gltf, placements);
        placedRoot = render.root;
        scene.add(placedRoot);
        generatedGeometries = render.generatedGeometries;
        hiddenLegacy = hideLegacyChairInstances(scene, placements.map((placement) => placement.id));
    
        return {
          status: {
            loaded: true,
            attempted: true,
            source: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.name,
            sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.source,
            assetUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url,
            assetId: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.id,
            license: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.license,
            licenseUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.licenseUrl,
            tier,
            stationIds: placements.map((placement) => placement.id),
            chairsPlaced: placements.length,
            trianglesPerChair: metrics.triangles,
            placedTriangles,
            sourceMeshes: metrics.meshes,
            sourceMaterials: metrics.materials,
            textures: metrics.textures,
            mergedDrawCalls: render.drawCalls,
            merged: render.merged,
            dimensionsMeters: metrics.size,
            floorOrigin: metrics.minY,
            fallbackInstancesHidden: hiddenLegacy.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + entry.saved.length, 0)
          },
          update() {},
          dispose() {
            if (disposed) return;
            disposed = true;
            if (placedRoot) scene.remove(placedRoot);
            for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
            restoreLegacyChairInstances(hiddenLegacy);
            if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            generatedGeometries = [];
            hiddenLegacy = [];
            placedRoot = null;
            gltf = null;
          }
        };
      } catch (error) {
        if (placedRoot) scene.remove(placedRoot);
        for (const geometry of generatedGeometries) geometry.dispose();
        restoreLegacyChairInstances(hiddenLegacy);
        if (gltf) disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
        const message = String(error?.message || error);
        return {
          status: {
            loaded: false,
            attempted: true,
            assetId: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.id,
            source: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.name,
            sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.source,
            assetUrl: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.url,
            license: CC0_OFFICE_CHAIR_ASSET.license,
            tier,
            chairsPlaced: 0,
            reason: message,
            errorCategory: /HTTP|fetch|network|CORS/i.test(message) ? 'http-or-network'
              : /mesh|material|texture|triangle|dimension|geometry|origin|floor/i.test(message) ? 'validation-or-geometry'
                : 'load-or-placement'
          },
          update() {},
          dispose() { disposed = true; }
        };
      }
    }

    export function transitionFirstShiftMission(current, type, detail = {}) {
      const state = {
        step: Number.isInteger(current?.step) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(6, current.step)) : 0,
        stationId: current?.stationId ?? null,
        stationLabel: current?.stationLabel ?? '',
        operation: current?.operation ?? '',
        shiftStarted: Boolean(current?.shiftStarted),
        briefingAttended: Boolean(current?.briefingAttended),
        customer: current?.customer ?? '',
        caseReference: current?.caseReference ?? '',
        disposition: current?.disposition ?? '',
        qa: Number.isFinite(Number(current?.qa)) ? Number(current.qa) : null,
        resolved: current?.resolved === true,
        assetStatus: current?.assetStatus ?? null
      };
    
      switch (type) {
        case 'nearest-station':
          if (detail.station) {
            state.stationId = detail.station.id ?? state.stationId;
            state.stationLabel = detail.station.label || state.stationLabel || 'Agent workstation';
            if (state.step < 1) state.step = 1;
          }
          break;
        case 'station-panel-opened':
          if (detail.hired === false && state.step < 6) state.step = 0;
          break;
        case 'employment-accepted':
          if (state.step < 1) state.step = 0;
          break;
        case 'station-accessed':
          state.stationId = detail.id ?? state.stationId;
          state.stationLabel = detail.label || state.stationLabel || 'Agent workstation';
          if (state.step < 2) state.step = 2;
          break;
        case 'operation-selected':
          state.operation = String(detail.view || '');
          if (state.operation === 'inbound') {
            if (detail.shiftActive) {
              state.shiftStarted = true;
              if (state.step < 4) state.step = 4;
            } else if (state.step < 3) state.step = 3;
          } else if (state.step < 2) {
            state.step = 2;
          }
          break;
        case 'briefing-attended':
          state.briefingAttended = true;
          if (state.step < 3) state.step = 3;
          break;
        case 'shift-started':
          state.shiftStarted = true;
          if (state.step < 4) state.step = 4;
          break;
        case 'call-connected':
          state.customer = String(detail.customer || 'Customer');
          if (state.step < 5) state.step = 5;
          break;
        case 'case-saved':
          state.caseReference = String(detail.reference || '');
          state.disposition = String(detail.disposition || 'recorded');
          state.qa = Number.isFinite(Number(detail.qa)) ? Number(detail.qa) : null;
          state.resolved = detail.resolved === true;
          state.step = 6;
          break;
        case 'assets-ready':
          state.assetStatus = {
            staff: Math.max(0, Number(detail.staff) || 0),
            office: Math.max(0, Number(detail.office) || 0),
            failures: Math.max(0, Number(detail.failures) || 0),
            loading: Boolean(detail.loading),
            tier: String(detail.tier || 'unknown')
          };
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
      return state;
    }
    
    export function createCalloriaWorldMission({ host, tier = 'balanced' } = {}) {
      if (!host || typeof document === 'undefined') return { dispose() {} };
    
      const previousPosition = host.style.position;

      };
    
      try {
        const saved = sessionStorage.getItem('calloria.first-shift-mission.v23');
        if (saved) {
          const restored = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (restored && typeof restored === 'object' && Number.isInteger(restored.step) && restored.step >= 0 && restored.step <= 6) {
            state = { ...state, ...restored };
            state.stationLabel = typeof state.stationLabel === 'string' ? state.stationLabel : '';
            state.operation = typeof state.operation === 'string' ? state.operation : '';
            state.customer = typeof state.customer === 'string' ? state.customer : '';
            state.caseReference = typeof state.caseReference === 'string' ? state.caseReference : '';
            state.disposition = typeof state.disposition === 'string' ? state.disposition : '';
            state.resolved = state.resolved === true;
          }
        }
      } catch { /* Session storage is optional. */ }

          <strong data-count>0/6</strong>

        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__bar"><i data-progress></i></div>
        <h3 data-title></h3>
        <p data-detail></p>
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__controls" data-controls></div>
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__assets" data-assets></div>
      `;

      `;
    
      host.append(card);
      if (!document.querySelector('style[data-calloria-first-shift="v23"]')) document.head.append(style);
    
      const nodes = {
        eyebrow: card.querySelector('[data-eyebrow]'),
        count: card.querySelector('[data-count]'),
        progress: card.querySelector('[data-progress]'),
        title: card.querySelector('[data-title]'),
        detail: card.querySelector('[data-detail]'),
        controls: card.querySelector('[data-controls]'),
        assets: card.querySelector('[data-assets]')
      };
    
      function render() {
        const index = Math.min(state.step, 5);
        const step = FIRST_SHIFT_STEPS[index];
        const complete = state.step >= 6;
        if (complete) {
          nodes.eyebrow.textContent = 'FIRST SHIFT · COMPLETED';
          nodes.count.textContent = '6/6';
          nodes.progress.style.width = '100%';
          nodes.title.textContent = 'First customer interaction recorded';
          const outcome = state.resolved ? 'Resolved' : state.disposition.replaceAll('_', ' ') || 'Recorded for review';
          const qaText = state.qa === null ? 'QA pending' : `QA ${state.qa}%`;
          nodes.detail.textContent = `${outcome} · ${qaText}. Case ${state.caseReference || 'recorded'}. Continue serving the queue and review your performance after the shift.`;
          nodes.controls.textContent = 'Your result comes from the saved case record; escalation and callback outcomes are not counted as resolved.';
          card.dataset.complete = 'true';
        } else {
          nodes.eyebrow.textContent = step.eyebrow;
          nodes.count.textContent = `${state.step}/6`;
          nodes.progress.style.width = `${Math.round((state.step / 6) * 100)}%`;
          nodes.title.textContent = step.title;
          nodes.detail.textContent = step.detail;
          nodes.controls.textContent = step.controls;
          card.dataset.complete = 'false';
        }
    
        if (state.assetStatus) {
          const { staff, office, failures, loading, tier: assetTier } = state.assetStatus;
          const total = staff + office;
          nodes.assets.textContent = total
            ? `CONFIRMED GLB: ${staff} STAFF · ${office} OFFICE OBJECTS · ${assetTier.toUpperCase()}${failures ? ` · ${failures} LOAD ERRORS` : ''}`
            : loading
              ? `GLB ASSETS LOADING · ${assetTier.toUpperCase()} DEVICE PROFILE`
              : `NO GLB MODELS CONFIRMED · PROCEDURAL FALLBACK · ${failures} LOAD ERRORS`;
        } else {
          nodes.assets.textContent = `DEVICE PROFILE: ${tier.toUpperCase()} · GLB COUNTS WILL APPEAR AFTER THE ASSET CHECK`;
        }
      }
    
      function dispatch(type, detail) {
        state = transitionFirstShiftMission(state, type, detail || {});
        try { sessionStorage.setItem('calloria.first-shift-mission.v23', JSON.stringify(state)); } catch { /* Optional. */ }
        render();
      }
    
      const onNearest = (event) => dispatch('nearest-station', { station: event.detail || null });
      const onStation = (event) => dispatch('station-accessed', event.detail || {});
      const onStationPanel = (event) => dispatch('station-panel-opened', event.detail || {});
      const onEmployment = (event) => dispatch('employment-accepted', event.detail || {});
      const onOperation = (event) => dispatch('operation-selected', event.detail || {});
      const onBriefing = (event) => dispatch('briefing-attended', event.detail || {});
      const onShift = (event) => dispatch('shift-started', event.detail || {});
      const onCall = (event) => dispatch('call-connected', event.detail || {});
      const onCase = (event) => dispatch('case-saved', event.detail || {});
      const onAssets = (event) => dispatch('assets-ready', event.detail || {});
      const onImmersive = () => render();
    
      const listeners = [
        ['calloria:world-nearest-station', onNearest],
        ['calloria:world-station-accessed', onStation],
        ['calloria:game-station-panel-opened', onStationPanel],
        ['calloria:game-employment-accepted', onEmployment],
        ['calloria:game-operation-selected', onOperation],
        ['calloria:game-briefing-attended', onBriefing],
        ['calloria:game-shift-started', onShift],
        ['calloria:game-call-connected', onCall],
        ['calloria:game-case-saved', onCase],
        ['calloria:glb-assets-ready', onAssets],
        ['calloria:world-immersive', onImmersive]
      ];
      for (const [type, handler] of listeners) window.addEventListener(type, handler);
      render();
    
      return {
        get state() { return { ...state }; },
        dispose() {
          for (const [type, handler] of listeners) window.removeEventListener(type, handler);
          card.remove();
          if (host.isConnected) host.style.position = previousPosition;
          if (style.isConnected && document.querySelectorAll('style[data-calloria-first-shift="v23"]').length <= 1) style.remove();
        }
      };
    }

    export function transitionFirstShiftMission(current, type, detail = {}) {
      const state = {
        step: Number.isInteger(current?.step) ? Math.max(0, Math.min(6, current.step)) : 0,
        stationId: current?.stationId ?? null,
        stationLabel: current?.stationLabel ?? '',
        operation: current?.operation ?? '',
        shiftStarted: Boolean(current?.shiftStarted),
        briefingAttended: Boolean(current?.briefingAttended),
        customer: current?.customer ?? '',
        caseReference: current?.caseReference ?? '',
        disposition: current?.disposition ?? '',
        qa: Number.isFinite(Number(current?.qa)) ? Number(current.qa) : null,
        resolved: current?.resolved === true,
        assetStatus: current?.assetStatus ?? null
      };
    
      switch (type) {
        case 'nearest-station':
          if (detail.station) {
            state.stationId = detail.station.id ?? state.stationId;
            state.stationLabel = detail.station.label || state.stationLabel || 'Agent workstation';
            if (state.step < 1) state.step = 1;
          }
          break;
        case 'station-panel-opened':
          if (detail.hired === false && state.step < 6) state.step = 0;
          break;
        case 'employment-accepted':
          if (state.step < 1) state.step = 0;
          break;
        case 'station-accessed':
          state.stationId = detail.id ?? state.stationId;
          state.stationLabel = detail.label || state.stationLabel || 'Agent workstation';
          if (state.step < 2) state.step = 2;
          break;
        case 'operation-selected':
          state.operation = String(detail.view || '');
          if (state.operation === 'inbound') {
            if (detail.shiftActive) {
              state.shiftStarted = true;
              if (state.step < 4) state.step = 4;
            } else if (state.step < 3) state.step = 3;
          } else if (state.step < 2) {
            state.step = 2;
          }
          break;
        case 'briefing-attended':
          state.briefingAttended = true;
          if (state.step < 3) state.step = 3;
          break;
        case 'shift-started':
          state.shiftStarted = true;
          if (state.step < 4) state.step = 4;
          break;
        case 'call-connected':
          state.customer = String(detail.customer || 'Customer');
          if (state.step < 5) state.step = 5;
          break;
        case 'case-saved':
          state.caseReference = String(detail.reference || '');
          state.disposition = String(detail.disposition || 'recorded');
          state.qa = Number.isFinite(Number(detail.qa)) ? Number(detail.qa) : null;
          state.resolved = detail.resolved === true;
          state.step = 6;
          break;
        case 'assets-ready':
          state.assetStatus = {
            staff: Math.max(0, Number(detail.staff) || 0),
            office: Math.max(0, Number(detail.office) || 0),
            failures: Math.max(0, Number(detail.failures) || 0),
            loading: Boolean(detail.loading),
            tier: String(detail.tier || 'unknown')
          };
          break;
        default:
          break;
      }
      return state;
    }
    
    export function createCalloriaWorldMission({ host, tier = 'balanced' } = {}) {
      if (!host || typeof document === 'undefined') return { dispose() {} };
    
      const previousPosition = host.style.position;
      if (getComputedStyle(host).position === 'static') host.style.position = 'relative';
    
      let state = {
        step: 0, stationId: null, stationLabel: '', operation: '',
        shiftStarted: false, briefingAttended: false, customer: '',
        caseReference: '', disposition: '', qa: null, resolved: false,
        assetStatus: null
      };
    
      try {
        const saved = sessionStorage.getItem('calloria.first-shift-mission.v23');
        if (saved) {
          const restored = JSON.parse(saved);
          if (restored && typeof restored === 'object' && Number.isInteger(restored.step) && restored.step >= 0 && restored.step <= 6) {
            state = { ...state, ...restored };
            state.stationLabel = typeof state.stationLabel === 'string' ? state.stationLabel : '';
            state.operation = typeof state.operation === 'string' ? state.operation : '';
            state.customer = typeof state.customer === 'string' ? state.customer : '';
            state.caseReference = typeof state.caseReference === 'string' ? state.caseReference : '';
            state.disposition = typeof state.disposition === 'string' ? state.disposition : '';
            state.resolved = state.resolved === true;
          }
        }
      } catch { /* Session storage is optional. */ }
    
      const card = document.createElement('aside');
      card.className = 'calloria-world-mission-v23';
      card.setAttribute('aria-live', 'polite');
      card.innerHTML = `
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__top">
          <span data-eyebrow>FIRST SHIFT · 1/6</span>
          <strong data-count>0/6</strong>
        </div>
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__bar"><i data-progress></i></div>
        <h3 data-title></h3>
        <p data-detail></p>
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__controls" data-controls></div>
        <div class="calloria-world-mission-v23__assets" data-assets></div>
      `;
    
      const style = document.createElement('style');
      style.dataset.calloriaFirstShift = 'v23';
      style.textContent = `
        .calloria-world-mission-v23{display:none;position:absolute;z-index:24;top:max(10px,env(safe-area-inset-top));left:10px;width:min(306px,calc(100% - 22px));padding:11px 13px 10px;border:1px solid rgba(103,211,198,.38);border-left:3px solid #39cbb2;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(4,18,28,.91);box-shadow:0 8px 26px rgba(0,0,0,.30);color:#eff8f6;pointer-events:none;backdrop-filter:blur(9px);font:inherit;}
        body.calloria-immersive .calloria-world-mission-v23{display:block;}
        .calloria-world-mission-v23__top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px;font-size:9px;letter-spacing:.15em;font-weight:850;color:#83dfd1;}
        .calloria-world-mission-v23__top strong{font-size:10px;color:#eaf8f4;letter-spacing:.06em;}
        .calloria-world-mission-v23__bar{height:4px;margin:8px 0 9px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.13);border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;}
        .calloria-world-mission-v23__bar i{display:block;width:0;height:100%;background:#40d0b8;border-radius:999px;transition:width .25s ease;}
        .calloria-world-mission-v23 h3{margin:0;font-size:14px;line-height:1.25;font-weight:850;}

        progress: card.querySelector('[data-progress]'),

        detail: card.querySelector('[data-detail]'),
        controls: card.querySelector('[data-controls]'),
        assets: card.querySelector('[data-assets]')
      };
    
      function render() {
        const index = Math.min(state.step, 5);
        const step = FIRST_SHIFT_STEPS[index];
        const complete = state.step >= 6;
        if (complete) {
          nodes.eyebrow.textContent = 'FIRST SHIFT · COMPLETED';
          nodes.count.textContent = '6/6';
          nodes.progress.style.width = '100%';
          nodes.title.textContent = 'First customer interaction recorded';
          const outcome = state.resolved ? 'Resolved' : state.disposition.replaceAll('_', ' ') || 'Recorded for review';

        }
