        root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        bounds = new T.Box3().setFromObject(root);
        size = bounds.getSize(new T.Vector3());
      }
      const factor = Math.min(
        target.x / Math.max(size.x, 0.001),
        target.y / Math.max(size.y, 0.001),
        target.z / Math.max(size.z, 0.001)
      );
      if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) throw new Error('Model could not be fitted into its workstation dimensions.');
      root.scale.multiplyScalar(factor);
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      bounds = new T.Box3().setFromObject(root);
      const center = bounds.getCenter(new T.Vector3());
      root.position.x -= center.x;
      root.position.z -= center.z;
      root.position.y -= bounds.min.y;
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh) {
          object.castShadow = false;
          object.receiveShadow = false;
          object.frustumCulled = true;
        }
      });
      return root;
    }
    
    function hideInstancedEntries(scene, name, indexes, stride = 1, T = THREE) {
      const mesh = scene.getObjectByName(name);
      if (!mesh?.isInstancedMesh || !indexes.length) return 0;
      const position = new T.Vector3();
      const quaternion = new T.Quaternion();
      const scale = new T.Vector3();
      const matrix = new T.Matrix4();
      let changed = 0;
      for (const stationIndex of indexes) {
        for (let sub = 0; sub < stride; sub += 1) {
          const instanceIndex = stationIndex * stride + sub;
          if (instanceIndex >= mesh.count) continue;
          mesh.getMatrixAt(instanceIndex, matrix);
          matrix.decompose(position, quaternion, scale);
          scale.set(0, 0, 0);
          matrix.compose(position, quaternion, scale);
          mesh.setMatrixAt(instanceIndex, matrix);
          changed += 1;
        }
      }
      if (changed) mesh.instanceMatrix.needsUpdate = true;
      return changed;
    }
    
    function hideNamedObjects(scene, names) {
      let hidden = 0;
      for (const name of names) {
        const object = scene.getObjectByName(name);
        if (object) {
          object.visible = false;
          hidden += 1;
        }
      }
      return hidden;
    }
    
    function addFittedInstance(scene, loaded, name, position, target, options = {}, T = THREE) {
      const wrapper = new T.Group();
      wrapper.name = name;
      wrapper.position.set(Number(position.x) || 0, Number(position.y) || 0, Number(position.z) || 0);
      const root = cloneAndFit(loaded, target, options, T);
      root.userData.calloriaSourceAsset = loaded.asset.id;
      root.userData.calloriaPlacement = name;
      wrapper.add(root);
      scene.add(wrapper);
      return wrapper;
    }
    
    function dispatchStatus(status) {
      if (typeof window === 'undefined' || typeof CustomEvent === 'undefined') return;
      window.dispatchEvent(new CustomEvent('calloria:office-glb-status', { detail: status }));
    }
    
    export async function integrateCalloriaGLBOfficeAssets({ THREE: suppliedThree, scene, stations = [], tier = 'balanced' } = {}) {
      const T = suppliedThree || THREE;
      if (!T?.Scene || !scene?.add || !Array.isArray(stations)) {
        throw new TypeError('CALLORIA office GLB integration requires the active Three.js scene and station list.');
      }
      const existing = ACTIVE_LAYERS.get(scene);
      if (existing && !existing.disposed) return existing;
    
      const plan = getOfficeAssetPlan(tier, stations.length);
      const loader = new GLTFLoader();
      loader.setCrossOrigin('anonymous');
      loader.setMeshoptDecoder(MeshoptDecoder);
      const dracoLoader = new DRACOLoader();
      const configuredDracoPath = typeof window !== 'undefined'
        ? window.CALLORIA_DRACO_DECODER_PATH
        : null;
      const dracoDecoderPath = getOfficeDracoDecoderPath(configuredDracoPath);
      dracoLoader.setDecoderPath(dracoDecoderPath);
      dracoLoader.setDecoderConfig({ type: 'wasm' });
      loader.setDRACOLoader(dracoLoader);
      const loaded = new Map();
      const loadPromises = new Map();
      const placed = [];
      const errors = [];
      const assetDetails = [];
      let chairLayer = null;
      let chairFurnitureStatus = { loaded: false, attempted: false, chairsPlaced: 0, reason: 'Chair activation has not completed.' };
      let lobbyLayer = null;
      let lobbyStatus = { loaded: false, attempted: false, reason: plan.tier === 'low' ? 'Lobby GLB skipped on low graphics tier; procedural reception retained.' : 'Lobby activation has not completed.' };
      let disposed = false;
    
      async function loadAsset(id) {
        if (loaded.has(id)) return loaded.get(id);
        if (loadPromises.has(id)) return loadPromises.get(id);
        const promise = (async () => {
          const asset = getAsset(id);
          let gltf;
          try {
            gltf = await loader.loadAsync(asset.url);
          } catch (error) {
            const failure = new Error(`${asset.name} could not be loaded from ${asset.url}: ${String(error?.message || error)}`);
            failure.cause = error;
            failure.assetId = id;
            failure.assetPath = asset.path;
            failure.errorCategory = classifyOfficeLoadError(error);
            throw failure;
          }
          if (disposed) {
            disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            throw new Error('World was disposed while the GLB was loading.');
          }
          const metrics = inspectModel(gltf, T);
          const check = validateOfficeAssetMetrics(id, metrics, plan.tier);
          const detail = {
            id,
            name: asset.name,
            path: asset.path,
            url: asset.url,
            status: check.valid ? 'validated' : 'rejected',
            renderMode: 'static-office-mesh',
            size: metrics.size,
            meshCount: metrics.meshCount,
            triangles: metrics.triangles,
            materialCount: metrics.materialCount,
            textureCount: metrics.textureCount,
            maxTextureEdge: metrics.maxTextureEdge,
            reasons: [...check.reasons]
          };
          assetDetails.push(detail);
          if (!check.valid) {
            disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            throw new Error(`${asset.name} rejected: ${check.reasons.join('; ')}.`);
          }
          const record = { asset, gltf, metrics, role: check.role };
          loaded.set(id, record);
          return record;
        })();
        loadPromises.set(id, promise);
        try {
          return await promise;
        } catch (error) {
          loadPromises.delete(id);
          const message = String(error?.message || error);
          const existingDetail = assetDetails.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
          if (existingDetail) {
            existingDetail.loadError = message;
            existingDetail.errorCategory = error?.errorCategory || classifyOfficeLoadError(error);
          } else {
            const asset = GLB_ASSET_REGISTRY.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
            assetDetails.push({
              id,
              name: asset?.name || id,
              path: asset?.path || null,
              url: asset?.url || null,
              status: 'load-failed',
              errorCategory: error?.errorCategory || classifyOfficeLoadError(error),
              reasons: [message]
            });
          }
          throw error;
        }
      }
    
      function recordError(id, error) {
        const message = String(error?.message || error);
        errors.push({ assetId: id, message });
        const existingDetail = assetDetails.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
        if (existingDetail) {
          existingDetail.placementStatus = 'failed';
          existingDetail.placementError = message;
        }
      }
    
      async function placeAsset(id, placementFactory) {
        try {
          const record = await loadAsset(id);
          if (disposed) return;
          const result = placementFactory(record);
          const additions = Array.isArray(result) ? result.filter(Boolean) : result ? [result] : [];
          placed.push(...additions);
          const detail = assetDetails.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
          if (detail) {
            detail.placementStatus = additions.length ? 'placed' : 'validated-not-selected';
            detail.placementCount = additions.length;
          }
          return additions;
        } catch (error) {
          recordError(id, error);
          return [];
        }
      }
    
      const deskStationIndexes = plan.deskStationIndexes;
      const headsetStationIndexes = plan.headsetStationIndexes;
      const includeReceptionDesk = plan.includeReceptionDesk;
    
      // Place independent asset families concurrently; one failed GLB never blocks
      // another valid desk, computer, headset or reception model from appearing.
      const jobs = [];
    
      // Task chairs use a separately validated CC0 model. Its failure is isolated:
      // the existing instanced chairs remain visible unless a batched GLB layer is placed.
      jobs.push((async () => {
        try {
          chairLayer = await integrateCalloriaCC0OfficeChairs({
            scene, stations, tier: plan.tier, isActive: () => !disposed
          });
          chairFurnitureStatus = chairLayer?.status || {
            loaded: false, attempted: true, chairsPlaced: 0, reason: 'Chair runtime returned no status.'
          };
        } catch (error) {
          chairFurnitureStatus = {
            loaded: false, attempted: true, chairsPlaced: 0,
            assetId: '3dassets-office-task-chair',
            reason: String(error?.message || error),
            errorCategory: /HTTP|fetch|network|CORS/i.test(String(error?.message || error)) ? 'http-or-network' : 'load-or-placement'
          };
        }
      })());
    
      if (deskStationIndexes.length) {
        jobs.push((async () => {
          const result = await placeAsset('office-desk', (record) => deskStationIndexes.flatMap((index) => {
            const station = stations[index];
            if (!station) return [];
            return [addFittedInstance(
              scene, record, `calloria-glb-desk-station-${station.id}`,
              { x: station.x, z: station.z }, TARGETS.desk, { alignLongAxis: true }, T
            )];
          }));
          if (result?.length) {
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'agent-desk-surfaces', deskStationIndexes, 1, T);
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'agent-desk-aprons', deskStationIndexes, 1, T);
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'agent-desk-legs', deskStationIndexes, 4, T);
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'desk-acoustic-dividers', deskStationIndexes, 1, T);
          }
        })());
      }
    
      if (plan.computerStationIndexes.length) {
        jobs.push((async () => {
          const result = await placeAsset('office-computer', (record) => plan.computerStationIndexes.flatMap((index) => {
            const station = stations[index];
            if (!station) return [];
            return [-0.52, 0.52].map((offset, screenIndex) => addFittedInstance(
              scene,
              record,
              `calloria-glb-computer-station-${station.id}-${screenIndex + 1}`,
              { x: station.x + offset, y: 0.84, z: station.z - 0.44 },
              TARGETS.computer,
              {},
              T
            ));
          }));
          if (result?.length) {
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'monitor-bezels', plan.computerStationIndexes, 2, T);
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'monitor-active-screens', plan.computerStationIndexes, 2, T);
            hideInstancedEntries(scene, 'monitor-stands', plan.computerStationIndexes, 2, T);
          }
        })());
      }
    
      if (headsetStationIndexes.length) {
        jobs.push(placeAsset('headset-model', (record) => headsetStationIndexes.map((index) => {
          const station = stations[index];
          if (!station) return null;
          return addFittedInstance(
            scene, record, `calloria-glb-headset-station-${station.id}`,
            { x: station.x + 1.0, y: 0.84, z: station.z + 0.18 },
            TARGETS.headset, {}, T
          );
        }).filter(Boolean)));
      }
    
      if (includeReceptionDesk && shouldLoadCC0OfficeLobby(plan.tier)) {
        jobs.push((async () => {
          try {
            lobbyLayer = await integrateCalloriaCC0OfficeLobby({
              THREE: T,
              scene,
              loader,
              tier: plan.tier,
              isActive: () => !disposed
            });
            lobbyStatus = lobbyLayer?.status || {
              loaded: false, attempted: true, reason: 'Lobby integration returned no status.'
            };
          } catch (error) {
            lobbyStatus = {
              loaded: false,
              attempted: true,
              id: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id,
              name: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.name,
              url: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.url,
              sourceUrl: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.sourceUrl,
              license: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.license,
              reason: String(error?.message || error),
              errorCategory: 'load-or-placement'
            };
          }
    
          // The complete lobby includes the reception counter, seating and access
          // gates. Only if it fails do we try the previous standalone reception
          // desk GLB. If that also fails, original procedural furniture remains.
          if (!disposed && !lobbyStatus.loaded) {
            const fallback = await placeAsset('reception-desk', (record) => [addFittedInstance(
              scene, record, 'calloria-glb-reception-desk',
              { x: -15.0, z: 11.85 }, TARGETS.reception, { alignLongAxis: true }, T
            )]);
            if (fallback?.length) hideNamedObjects(scene, ['reception-counter-top', 'reception-counter-front', 'reception-counter-accent']);
          }
        })());
      }
    
      await Promise.allSettled(jobs);
    
      const placedIds = [...new Set(placed.map((entry) => entry.children?.[0]?.userData?.calloriaSourceAsset).filter(Boolean))];
      const chairCount = Math.max(0, Math.floor(Number(chairFurnitureStatus.chairsPlaced) || 0));
      if (chairCount > 0) placedIds.push('3dassets-office-task-chair');
      const lobbyCount = lobbyStatus.loaded ? 1 : 0;
      if (lobbyCount > 0) placedIds.push(CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id);
      const officePlacedCount = placed.length + chairCount + lobbyCount;
      const chairAssetDetail = {
        id: '3dassets-office-task-chair',
        name: 'CC0 ergonomic workstation task chair',
        path: null,
        url: chairFurnitureStatus.assetUrl || null,
        sourceUrl: chairFurnitureStatus.sourceUrl || null,
        license: chairFurnitureStatus.license || 'CC0 1.0 Universal',
        status: chairFurnitureStatus.loaded ? 'validated-and-placed' : chairFurnitureStatus.attempted ? 'load-failed-or-rejected' : 'not-attempted',
        placementStatus: chairCount > 0 ? 'placed' : 'fallback-retained',
        placementCount: chairCount,
        reasons: chairFurnitureStatus.reason ? [chairFurnitureStatus.reason] : []
      };
      const lobbyAssetDetail = {
        id: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id,
        name: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.name,
        path: null,
        url: lobbyStatus.url || CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.url,
        sourceUrl: lobbyStatus.sourceUrl || CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.sourceUrl,
        license: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.license,
        licenseUrl: CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.licenseUrl,
        status: lobbyStatus.loaded ? 'validated-and-placed' : lobbyStatus.attempted ? 'load-failed-or-rejected' : 'not-attempted',
        placementStatus: lobbyStatus.loaded ? 'placed' : lobbyStatus.attempted ? 'fallback-retained' : 'not-selected-for-device-tier',
        placementCount: lobbyCount,
        triangles: lobbyStatus.triangles || null,
        sourceMeshes: lobbyStatus.meshes || null,
        drawCalls: lobbyStatus.drawCalls || null,
        merged: lobbyStatus.merged ?? null,
        reasons: lobbyStatus.reason ? [lobbyStatus.reason] : []
      };
      const failedIds = errors.map((entry) => entry.assetId);
      if (chairFurnitureStatus.attempted && !chairFurnitureStatus.loaded) failedIds.push('3dassets-office-task-chair');
      if (lobbyStatus.attempted && !lobbyStatus.loaded) failedIds.push(CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id);
      const status = Object.freeze({
        placed: officePlacedCount,
        officeObjectsPlaced: officePlacedCount,
        assets: placedIds,
        loadedAssetIds: [...loaded.keys(), ...(chairFurnitureStatus.loaded ? ['3dassets-office-task-chair'] : []), ...(lobbyStatus.loaded ? [CC0_OFFICE_LOBBY_ASSET.id] : [])],
        failedAssetIds: [...new Set(failedIds)],
        chairFurniture: { ...chairFurnitureStatus },
        receptionLobby: { ...lobbyStatus },
        tier: plan.tier,
        stationCount: stations.length,
        decoders: {
          meshopt: true,
          draco: true,
          dracoPath: dracoDecoderPath,
          dracoMode: 'wasm'
        },
        deskStations: loaded.has('office-desk') ? deskStationIndexes.map((index) => stations[index]?.id).filter(Boolean) : [],
        planned: {
          deskStations: [...deskStationIndexes],
          computerStations: [...plan.computerStationIndexes],
          headsetStations: [...headsetStationIndexes],
          includeReceptionDesk
        },
        assetDetails: [...assetDetails.map((entry) => ({ ...entry, reasons: [...(entry.reasons || [])] })), chairAssetDetail, lobbyAssetDetail],
        errors: errors.map((entry) => ({ ...entry })),
        reason: officePlacedCount
          ? `${officePlacedCount} real office GLB placement(s), including ${chairCount} task chair(s) and ${lobbyCount} complete reception lobby, are visible.`
          : jobs.length
            ? 'No office GLB was placed. Review the per-asset HTTP, geometry and placement diagnostics.'
            : 'No office placements were planned for the current device tier or station count.'
      });
    
      const layer = {
        status,
        disposed: false,
        update() {},
        dispose() {
          if (disposed) return;
          disposed = true;
          this.disposed = true;
          lobbyLayer?.dispose?.();
          lobbyLayer = null;
          chairLayer?.dispose?.();
          chairLayer = null;
          for (const object of placed) {
            scene.remove(object);
            object.clear?.();
          }
          placed.length = 0;
          for (const entry of loaded.values()) disposeGLTFResources(entry.gltf);
          dracoLoader.dispose();
          loaded.clear();
          loadPromises.clear();
          if (ACTIVE_LAYERS.get(scene) === layer) ACTIVE_LAYERS.delete(scene);
        }
      };
      ACTIVE_LAYERS.set(scene, layer);
      dispatchStatus(status);
      return layer;
    }

    function inspectModel(gltf, T = THREE) {
      const root = gltf?.scene;
      if (!root) throw new Error('GLB has no default scene.');
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);

      const size = bounds.getSize(new T.Vector3());
      let meshCount = 0;
      let triangles = 0;
      const materials = new Set();
      const textures = new Set();
      const textureSlots = ['map', 'normalMap', 'roughnessMap', 'metalnessMap', 'emissiveMap', 'aoMap'];

        meshCount += 1;
        const vertexCount = object.geometry?.index?.count
          ?? object.geometry?.getAttribute?.('position')?.count

          ? object.material

        for (const material of objectMaterials) {
          materials.add(material);
          for (const slot of textureSlots) {

    function cloneAndFit(loaded, target, { alignLongAxis = false, yaw = 0 } = {}, T = THREE) {
      const root = loaded.gltf.scene.clone(true);
      root.rotation.y = yaw;
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      let bounds = new T.Box3().setFromObject(root);
      let size = bounds.getSize(new T.Vector3());
      if (alignLongAxis && size.z > size.x) {
        root.rotation.y += Math.PI / 2;
        root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
        bounds = new T.Box3().setFromObject(root);
        size = bounds.getSize(new T.Vector3());
      }
      const factor = Math.min(
        target.x / Math.max(size.x, 0.001),
        target.y / Math.max(size.y, 0.001),
        target.z / Math.max(size.z, 0.001)
      );
      if (!Number.isFinite(factor) || factor <= 0) throw new Error('Model could not be fitted into its workstation dimensions.');
      root.scale.multiplyScalar(factor);
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      bounds = new T.Box3().setFromObject(root);

    function hideInstancedEntries(scene, name, indexes, stride = 1, T = THREE) {

    export async function integrateCalloriaGLBOfficeAssets({ THREE: suppliedThree, scene, stations = [], tier = 'balanced' } = {}) {
      const T = suppliedThree || THREE;

        if (loadPromises.has(id)) return loadPromises.get(id);

          let gltf;

            gltf = await loader.loadAsync(asset.url);
          } catch (error) {

            failure.cause = error;
            failure.assetId = id;
            failure.assetPath = asset.path;
            failure.errorCategory = classifyOfficeLoadError(error);
            throw failure;
          }
          if (disposed) {
            disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            throw new Error('World was disposed while the GLB was loading.');
          }
          const metrics = inspectModel(gltf, T);
          const check = validateOfficeAssetMetrics(id, metrics, plan.tier);
          const detail = {
            id,
            name: asset.name,
            path: asset.path,
            url: asset.url,
            status: check.valid ? 'validated' : 'rejected',
            renderMode: 'static-office-mesh',
            size: metrics.size,
            meshCount: metrics.meshCount,
            triangles: metrics.triangles,
            materialCount: metrics.materialCount,
            textureCount: metrics.textureCount,
            maxTextureEdge: metrics.maxTextureEdge,
            reasons: [...check.reasons]
          };
          assetDetails.push(detail);
          if (!check.valid) {
            disposeGLTFResources(gltf);
            throw new Error(`${asset.name} rejected: ${check.reasons.join('; ')}.`);
          }
          const record = { asset, gltf, metrics, role: check.role };
          loaded.set(id, record);
          return record;
        })();
        loadPromises.set(id, promise);
        try {
          return await promise;
        } catch (error) {
          loadPromises.delete(id);
          const message = String(error?.message || error);
          const existingDetail = assetDetails.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
          if (existingDetail) {
            existingDetail.loadError = message;
            existingDetail.errorCategory = error?.errorCategory || classifyOfficeLoadError(error);
          } else {
            const asset = GLB_ASSET_REGISTRY.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
            assetDetails.push({
              id,
              name: asset?.name || id,
              path: asset?.path || null,
              url: asset?.url || null,
              status: 'load-failed',
              errorCategory: error?.errorCategory || classifyOfficeLoadError(error),
              reasons: [message]
            });
          }
          throw error;
        }
      }
    
      function recordError(id, error) {
        const message = String(error?.message || error);
        errors.push({ assetId: id, message });
        const existingDetail = assetDetails.find((entry) => entry.id === id);
        if (existingDetail) {
          existingDetail.placementStatus = 'failed';
          existingDetail.placementError = message;
        }
      }
    
      async function placeAsset(id, placementFactory) {
        try {
          const record = await loadAsset(id);

          return additions;
        } catch (error) {

          return [];

    function readApprovedIds() {
      try {
        const data = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(INSPECTOR_STORAGE_KEY) || '{}');
        const explicit = Array.isArray(data.approvedAssetIds) ? data.approvedAssetIds : [];
        const selected = explicit.filter((id) => CALLORIA_STAFF_DEFAULT_CANDIDATES.includes(id));

    function inspectRuntimeModel(gltf) {
      const root = gltf?.scene;
      if (!root) throw new Error('GLB has no default scene.');
      root.updateMatrixWorld(true);
      const bounds = new THREE.Box3().setFromObject(root);
      const size = bounds.getSize(new THREE.Vector3());
      const metrics = { meshes: 0, skinnedMeshes: 0, triangles: 0, materials: new Set(), textures: new Set(), bones: new Set() };
      const textureSlots = ['map', 'normalMap', 'roughnessMap', 'metalnessMap', 'emissiveMap', 'alphaMap', 'aoMap'];
    
      root.traverse((object) => {
        if (!(object.isMesh || object.isSkinnedMesh || object.isInstancedMesh)) return;
        metrics.meshes += 1;
        if (object.isSkinnedMesh) {
          metrics.skinnedMeshes += 1;
          if (object.skeleton) metrics.bones.add(object.skeleton);
        }
        const position = object.geometry?.getAttribute?.('position');
        const count = object.geometry?.index?.count ?? position?.count ?? 0;
        metrics.triangles += Math.floor(count / 3) * (object.isInstancedMesh ? Math.max(1, object.count) : 1);
        const materials = Array.isArray(object.material) ? object.material : object.material ? [object.material] : [];
        for (const material of materials) {
          metrics.materials.add(material);
          for (const slot of textureSlots) if (material[slot]?.isTexture) metrics.textures.add(material[slot]);
        }
      });
    
      const textureEdge = [...metrics.textures].reduce((max, texture) => {
        const image = texture.source?.data || texture.image;
        return Math.max(max, Number(image?.width || 0), Number(image?.height || 0));
      }, 0);
    
      return {
        bounds,
        size: { x: size.x, y: size.y, z: size.z },
        meshCount: metrics.meshes,

        triangleCount: metrics.triangles,
        materialCount: metrics.materials.size,
        textureCount: metrics.textures.size,
        maxTextureEdge: textureEdge
      };
    }

          return Promise.reject(error);
        }
        const bounded = (value, fallback, min, max) => {
          const number = Number(value);
          return Number.isFinite(number) ? Math.max(min, Math.min(max, number)) : fallback;
        };
        utterance.rate = bounded(settings.rate, 1, 0.5, 2);
        utterance.pitch = bounded(settings.pitch, 1, 0.5, 2);
        utterance.volume = bounded(settings.volume, 1, 0, 1);
        const intensity = bounded(settings.intensity, 0.68, 0, 1);
        if (typeof settings.lang === 'string' && settings.lang.trim()) {
          utterance.lang = settings.lang.trim().slice(0, 35);
        }
        const wantedVoice = String(settings.voiceURI || settings.voiceName || '').trim();
        if (wantedVoice) {
          const selectedVoice = getVoices().find((voice) => voice.voiceURI === wantedVoice || voice.name === wantedVoice);
          if (selectedVoice) {
            const browserVoice = (hostWindow.speechSynthesis?.getVoices?.() || []).find((voice) =>
              String(voice?.voiceURI || '') === selectedVoice.voiceURI
            );
            if (browserVoice) utterance.voice = browserVoice;
          }
        }
    
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          const current = { assetId, intensity, utterance, resolve, reject, started: false };
          activeSpeech = current;
          utterance.onstart = () => {
            if (activeSpeech !== current) return;
            current.started = true;
            emitSpeaking(assetId, true, intensity);
          };
          utterance.onend = () => {
            if (activeSpeech !== current) return;
            activeSpeech = null;
            if (current.started) emitSpeaking(assetId, false, intensity);
            resolve({ status: 'ended', assetId });
          };
          utterance.onerror = (event) => {
            if (activeSpeech !== current) return;
            activeSpeech = null;
            if (current.started) emitSpeaking(assetId, false, intensity);
            const reason = String(event?.error || 'speech synthesis failed');
            reject(new Error(`Browser speech synthesis ${reason}.`));
          };
          try {
            hostWindow.speechSynthesis.speak(utterance);
          } catch (error) {
            if (activeSpeech === current) activeSpeech = null;
            reject(error);
          }
        });
      };
    
      // Explicit queue API for multi-sentence agent replies and short scripted
      // dialogue. Direct speak() remains interruptive and clears any waiting jobs.
      const clearQueue = (requestedAssetId = '') => {
        const requested = String(requestedAssetId || '').trim();
        let cleared = 0;
        for (let index = speechQueue.length - 1; index >= 0; index -= 1) {
          const entry = speechQueue[index];
          if (requested && entry.assetId !== requested) continue;
          speechQueue.splice(index, 1);
          entry.resolve({ status: 'cancelled', assetId: entry.assetId, queueId: entry.id });
          cleared += 1;
        }
        return cleared;
      };
    
      const pumpQueue = () => {
        if (queueActive || queuePaused || !speechQueue.length) return;
        const entry = speechQueue.shift();
        queueActive = true;
        Promise.resolve()
          .then(() => {
            // pause() can run synchronously after enqueue() and before this
            // microtask. Put the line back without starting browser audio.
            if (queuePaused) {
              speechQueue.unshift(entry);
              return { status: 'deferred' };
            }
            return speakNow(entry.payload);
          })
          .then((result) => {
            if (result?.status === 'deferred') return;
            entry.resolve({ ...result, queueId: entry.id });
          }, entry.reject)
          .finally(() => {
            queueActive = false;
            if (!queuePaused) pumpQueue();
          });
      };
    
      const enqueue = (payload = {}) => {
        const settings = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        const assetId = String(settings.assetId || settings.agentId || '').trim();
        const text = String(settings.text || '').trim();
        if (!assetId) return Promise.reject(new TypeError('A staff assetId is required for queued speech.'));
        if (!text || text.length > 2000) return Promise.reject(new RangeError('Queued speech text must contain between 1 and 2000 characters.'));
        if (!isSupported()) return Promise.reject(new Error('Browser speech synthesis is not available in this browser.'));
        if (speechQueue.length >= 30) return Promise.reject(new RangeError('The staff voice queue is full (30 pending lines).'));
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          speechQueue.push({ id: nextQueueId++, assetId, payload: { ...settings, assetId, text }, resolve, reject });
          pumpQueue();
        });
      };
    
      const speak = (payload = {}) => {
        clearQueue();
        return speakNow(payload);
      };
    
      const pause = () => {
        if (!isSupported()) return false;
        queuePaused = true;
        try { hostWindow.speechSynthesis.pause?.(); } catch { /* Browser may not expose pause on this device. */ }
        return true;
      };
    
      const resume = () => {
        if (!isSupported()) return false;
        queuePaused = false;
        try { hostWindow.speechSynthesis.resume?.(); } catch { /* Browser may not expose resume on this device. */ }
        pumpQueue();
        return true;
      };
    
      const getQueueState = () => ({
        queued: speechQueue.length,
        active: Boolean(activeSpeech),
        activeAssetId: activeSpeech?.assetId || null,
        paused: queuePaused,
        queuedAssetIds: speechQueue.map((entry) => entry.assetId)
      });
    
      const api = Object.freeze({
        __calloriaNativeSpeechBridge: true,
        isSupported,
        getVoices,
        speak,
        enqueue,
        pause,
        resume,
        clearQueue,
        getQueueState,
        stop,
        cancel: stop
      });
      try {
        hostWindow.CalloriaStaffVoice = api;
      } catch {
        return null;
      }
      return api;
    })(window);
        (function installCalloriaStaffDialogueAdapter(hostWindow) {
      if (!hostWindow || typeof hostWindow.dispatchEvent !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.addEventListener !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.removeEventListener !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.CustomEvent !== 'function') return null;
    
      const existing = hostWindow.CalloriaStaffDialogue;
      if (existing && typeof existing === 'object') return existing;
    
      const voice = hostWindow.CalloriaStaffVoice;
      if (!voice || typeof voice.enqueue !== 'function' || typeof voice.speak !== 'function') return null;
    
      let sequence = 0;
      let received = 0;
      let completed = 0;
      let failed = 0;
      let lastAction = null;
      let lastAssetId = null;
      let lastError = null;
      let disposed = false;
      const pending = new Map();
    
      const emitResult = (detail) => {
        try {
          hostWindow.dispatchEvent(new hostWindow.CustomEvent('calloria:staff-dialogue-result', { detail }));
        } catch { /* A consumer may remove event plumbing during page teardown. */ }
      };
    
      const execute = async (detail = {}) => {
        const settings = detail && typeof detail === 'object' ? detail : {};
        const requestId = String(settings.requestId || `external-${++sequence}`).slice(0, 100);
        const action = String(settings.action || 'enqueue').trim().toLowerCase();
        const assetId = String(settings.assetId || settings.agentId || '').trim();
        received += 1;
        lastAction = action;
        lastAssetId = assetId || null;
        lastError = null;
    
        try {
          let result;
          switch (action) {
            case 'say':
            case 'enqueue':
              result = await voice.enqueue({ ...settings, assetId });
              break;
            case 'interrupt':
            case 'speak':
              result = await voice.speak({ ...settings, assetId });
              break;
            case 'stop':
              result = voice.stop(assetId);
              break;
            case 'pause':
              result = voice.pause();
              break;
            case 'resume':
              result = voice.resume();
              break;
            case 'clear':
            case 'clear-queue':
              result = voice.clearQueue(assetId);
              break;
            default:
              throw new TypeError(`Unsupported staff dialogue action: ${action || '(empty)'}.`);
          }
          completed += 1;
          emitResult({ requestId, action, status: 'completed', result });
          return result;
        } catch (error) {
          failed += 1;
          lastError = String(error?.message || error);
          emitResult({ requestId, action, status: 'error', error: lastError });
          throw error;
        }
      };
    
      const handleRequest = (event) => {
        if (disposed) return;
        const detail = event?.detail && typeof event.detail === 'object' ? event.detail : {};
        const requestId = String(detail.requestId || `external-${++sequence}`).slice(0, 100);
        void execute({ ...detail, requestId }).catch(() => {
          // Errors are exposed through calloria:staff-dialogue-result and diagnostics.
        });
      };
    
      const handleResult = (event) => {
        const detail = event?.detail || {};
        const waiter = pending.get(String(detail.requestId || ''));
        if (!waiter) return;
        pending.delete(String(detail.requestId));
        if (detail.status === 'completed') waiter.resolve(detail.result);
        else waiter.reject(new Error(String(detail.error || 'Staff dialogue request failed.')));
      };
    
      hostWindow.addEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-request', handleRequest);
      hostWindow.addEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-result', handleResult);
    
      const request = (payload = {}) => {
        if (disposed) return Promise.reject(new Error('Staff dialogue adapter has been disposed.'));
        const detail = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        const requestId = `dialogue-${++sequence}`;
        return new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
          pending.set(requestId, { resolve, reject });
          try {
            hostWindow.dispatchEvent(new hostWindow.CustomEvent('calloria:staff-dialogue-request', {
              detail: { ...detail, requestId }
            }));
          } catch (error) {
            pending.delete(requestId);
            reject(error);
          }
        });
      };
    
      const api = Object.freeze({
        __calloriaStaffDialogueAdapter: true,
        request,
        say: (payload = {}) => request({ ...payload, action: 'enqueue' }),
        interrupt: (payload = {}) => request({ ...payload, action: 'interrupt' }),
        stop: (assetId = '') => request({ action: 'stop', assetId }),
        pause: () => request({ action: 'pause' }),
        resume: () => request({ action: 'resume' }),
        clearQueue: (assetId = '') => request({ action: 'clear', assetId }),
        getStatus: () => ({
          received, completed, failed, pendingRequests: pending.size,
          lastAction, lastAssetId, lastError,
          voice: typeof voice.getQueueState === 'function' ? voice.getQueueState() : null,
          supported: typeof voice.isSupported === 'function' ? voice.isSupported() : null
        }),
        dispose: () => {
          if (disposed) return false;
          disposed = true;
          hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-request', handleRequest);
          hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-result', handleResult);
          for (const waiter of pending.values()) waiter.reject(new Error('Staff dialogue adapter has been disposed.'));
          pending.clear();
          try {
            if (hostWindow.CalloriaStaffDialogue === api) delete hostWindow.CalloriaStaffDialogue;
          } catch { /* Read-only host globals are tolerated. */ }
          return true;
        }
      });
    
      try {
        hostWindow.CalloriaStaffDialogue = api;
      } catch {
        hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-request', handleRequest);
        hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:staff-dialogue-result', handleResult);
        return null;
      }
      return api;
    })(window);
        (function installCalloriaContactSessionDialogueBridge(hostWindow) {
      if (!hostWindow || typeof hostWindow.dispatchEvent !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.addEventListener !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.removeEventListener !== 'function'
          || typeof hostWindow.CustomEvent !== 'function') return null;
    
      const existing = hostWindow.CalloriaContactDialogue;
      if (existing && typeof existing === 'object') return existing;
      const dialogue = hostWindow.CalloriaStaffDialogue;
      if (!dialogue || typeof dialogue.say !== 'function'
          || typeof dialogue.interrupt !== 'function') return null;
    
      const MAX_TEXT_LENGTH = 3000;
      const safeText = (value) => String(value ?? '').trim().slice(0, MAX_TEXT_LENGTH);
      const safeToken = (value, label, max = 100) => {
        const token = String(value ?? '').trim();
        if (!token || token.length > max || !/^[a-zA-Z0-9_.:-]+$/.test(token)) {
          throw new TypeError(`Invalid contact dialogue ${label}.`);
        }
        return token;
      };
      let sequence = 0;
      let received = 0;
      let completed = 0;
      let failed = 0;
      let disposed = false;
      let active = null;
      let lastError = null;
      const seenRequestIds = new Set();
    
      const emit = (type, detail = {}) => {
        try { hostWindow.dispatchEvent(new hostWindow.CustomEvent(type, { detail })); }
        catch { /* A host may be tearing down its event target. */ }
      };
      const snapshot = () => active ? Object.freeze({
        sessionId: active.sessionId,
        assetId: active.assetId,
        state: active.state,
        startedAt: active.startedAt,
        utterances: active.utterances
      }) : null;
      const requireSession = (sessionId = '') => {
        if (!active) throw new Error('No active contact dialogue session.');
        if (sessionId && String(sessionId) !== active.sessionId) {
          throw new Error('Contact dialogue session does not match the active call.');
        }
        return active;
      };
      const publishState = (reason) => emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-state', {
        session: snapshot(), reason, received, completed, failed, lastError
      });
      const stopSessionVoice = async (session) => {
        if (!session) return;
        try { await dialogue.stop(session.assetId); } catch { /* Best-effort cancellation. */ }
        try { await dialogue.clearQueue(session.assetId); } catch { /* Best-effort queue cleanup. */ }
      };
    
      const start = async (payload = {}) => {
        if (disposed) throw new Error('Contact dialogue bridge has been disposed.');
        const settings = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        const sessionId = safeToken(settings.sessionId, 'session ID');
        const assetId = safeToken(settings.assetId || settings.agentId, 'staff asset ID', 80);
        if (active?.sessionId === sessionId && active.assetId === assetId) {
          // Replayed connect events must not silently resume a held call.
          publishState('session-refreshed');
          return snapshot();
        }
        const previous = active;
        active = null;
        if (previous) await stopSessionVoice(previous);
        active = {
          sessionId, assetId, state: 'connected', startedAt: Date.now(), utterances: 0
        };
        lastError = null;
        publishState(previous ? 'session-replaced' : 'session-started');
        return snapshot();
      };
    
      const say = async (payload = {}) => {
        if (disposed) throw new Error('Contact dialogue bridge has been disposed.');
        const settings = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        const session = requireSession(settings.sessionId || '');
        if (session.state !== 'connected') throw new Error('Contact dialogue is not connected; resume the session before speaking.');
        const text = safeText(settings.text);
        if (!text) throw new TypeError('Contact dialogue text is required.');
        received += 1;
        session.utterances += 1;
        lastError = null;
        try {
          const result = await dialogue.say({
            ...settings,
            sessionId: session.sessionId,
            assetId: session.assetId,
            text,
            lang: String(settings.lang || 'en-NG').slice(0, 35)
          });
          completed += 1;
          emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-utterance', {
            sessionId: session.sessionId, assetId: session.assetId,
            status: 'completed', result, utterance: session.utterances
          });
          publishState('utterance-completed');
          return result;
        } catch (error) {
          failed += 1;
          lastError = String(error?.message || error);
          emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-utterance', {
            sessionId: session.sessionId, assetId: session.assetId,
            status: 'error', error: lastError, utterance: session.utterances
          });
          publishState('utterance-failed');
          throw error;
        }
      };
    
      const interrupt = async (payload = {}) => {
        if (disposed) throw new Error('Contact dialogue bridge has been disposed.');
        const settings = payload && typeof payload === 'object' ? payload : {};
        const session = requireSession(settings.sessionId || '');
        if (session.state !== 'connected') throw new Error('Contact dialogue is not connected; resume the session before speaking.');
        const text = safeText(settings.text);
        if (!text) throw new TypeError('Contact dialogue interruption text is required.');
        received += 1;
        session.utterances += 1;
        try {
          const result = await dialogue.interrupt({
            ...settings, sessionId: session.sessionId, assetId: session.assetId,
            text, lang: String(settings.lang || 'en-NG').slice(0, 35)
          });
          completed += 1;
          publishState('utterance-interrupted');
          return result;
        } catch (error) {
          failed += 1;
          lastError = String(error?.message || error);
          publishState('interruption-failed');
          throw error;
        }
      };
    
      const hold = async (sessionId = '') => {
        const session = requireSession(sessionId);
        if (session.state === 'ended') return false;
        const result = await dialogue.pause();
        session.state = 'held';
        publishState('session-held');
        return result;
      };
      const resume = async (sessionId = '') => {
        const session = requireSession(sessionId);
        const result = await dialogue.resume();
        session.state = 'connected';
        publishState('session-resumed');
        return result;
      };
      const end = async (sessionId = '') => {
        if (!active) return false;
        const session = requireSession(sessionId);
        active = null;
        await stopSessionVoice(session);
        publishState('session-ended');
        return true;
      };
    
      const executeEvent = async (detail = {}) => {
        const settings = detail && typeof detail === 'object' ? detail : {};
        const requestId = String(settings.requestId || `contact-${++sequence}`).slice(0, 100);
        if (seenRequestIds.has(requestId)) {
          emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-result', { requestId, status: 'duplicate' });
          return;
        }
        seenRequestIds.add(requestId);
        if (seenRequestIds.size > 250) seenRequestIds.delete(seenRequestIds.values().next().value);
        const action = String(settings.action || 'say').trim().toLowerCase();
        try {
          let result;
          if (action === 'start') result = await start(settings);
          else if (action === 'say' || action === 'enqueue') result = await say(settings);
          else if (action === 'interrupt') result = await interrupt(settings);
          else if (action === 'hold') result = await hold(settings.sessionId || '');
          else if (action === 'resume') result = await resume(settings.sessionId || '');
          else if (action === 'end') result = await end(settings.sessionId || '');
          else throw new TypeError(`Unsupported contact dialogue action: ${action || '(empty)'}.`);
          emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-result', { requestId, action, status: 'completed', result });
        } catch (error) {
          lastError = String(error?.message || error);
          emit('calloria:contact-dialogue-result', { requestId, action, status: 'error', error: lastError });
        }
      };
      const handleEvent = (event) => { if (!disposed) void executeEvent(event?.detail || {}); };
      hostWindow.addEventListener('calloria:contact-dialogue', handleEvent);
    
      const api = Object.freeze({
        __calloriaContactDialogueBridge: true,
        start,
        say,
        interrupt,
        hold,
        resume,
        end,
        getStatus: () => Object.freeze({
          active: snapshot(), received, completed, failed, lastError,
          speechSupported: typeof hostWindow.CalloriaStaffVoice?.isSupported === 'function'
            ? hostWindow.CalloriaStaffVoice.isSupported() : null
        }),
        dispose: async () => {
          if (disposed) return false;
          disposed = true;
          hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:contact-dialogue', handleEvent);
          const previous = active;
          active = null;
          if (previous) await stopSessionVoice(previous);
          try { if (hostWindow.CalloriaContactDialogue === api) delete hostWindow.CalloriaContactDialogue; }
          catch { /* Read-only global objects are tolerated. */ }
          return true;
        }
      });
      try { hostWindow.CalloriaContactDialogue = api; }
      catch {
        hostWindow.removeEventListener('calloria:contact-dialogue', handleEvent);
        return null;
      }
      return api;
    })(window);
      }
      /* __CALLORIA_STAFF_DIALOGUE_EVENT_ADAPTER_V639__ */
      /* __CALLORIA_CONTACT_SESSION_DIALOGUE_BRIDGE_V640__ */
      const proceduralIdleUpdateHz = tier === 'low' ? 12 : tier === 'high' ? 30 : 20;
      const proceduralIdleVisibilityInterval = 0.25;
      const replacements = [];
      const rejected = [];
      const staffTargets = staff.filter((person) => person && person.root && !person.walking);
    
      if (!candidates.length || !staffTargets.length) {
        return {
          status: {
            loaded: 0,
            fallback: staff.length,
            mode: 'merged-articulated-local-staff',
            approvedCandidates: candidates.length,
            reason: candidates.length ? 'No compatible staff positions were available.' : 'No character models have been approved in the GLB inspector.'
          },
          update() {},
          dispose() {}
        };
      }
    
      for (const asset of candidates.slice(0, maxCandidates)) {
        try {
          const gltf = await loader.loadAsync(asset.url);
          const metrics = inspectRuntimeModel(gltf);
          const humanScale = metrics.size.y >= 0.4 && metrics.size.y <= 5.0
            && metrics.size.x >= 0.04 && metrics.size.x <= 3.5
            && metrics.size.z >= 0.04 && metrics.size.z <= 3.5
            && metrics.size.x / Math.max(metrics.size.y, 0.001) <= 1.0

          const usableSkin = metrics.skinnedMeshCount > 0 && metrics.skeletonCount > 0 && metrics.boneCount >= 1;
          const rigValid = staffRenderMode === 'static-mesh'
            || staffRenderMode === 'animated-node-transforms'

            || (!staffRenderMode && metrics.skinnedMeshCount > 0 && metrics.skeletonCount > 0 && metrics.boneCount >= 15);

            if (!texturesValid) reasons.push('texture exceeds 4096 pixels');

            fallback: staff.length,
            mode: 'merged-articulated-local-staff',
            approvedCandidates: candidates.length,

          },

          dispose() { disposeSourceModels(loadedModels); }

          const candidateClip = chooseClip(candidate.gltf.animations, Boolean(person.seated));
          const isStaticPose = ['skinned-static-pose', 'static-mesh'].includes(candidateRenderMode);

        const originalHeight = Math.max(0.001, originalBounds.max.y - originalBounds.min.y);

        clonedRoot.scale.multiplyScalar(targetHeight / originalHeight);

        const idleExpressionMorphTargets = [];

        const idleSpeechMorphTargets = [];
        if (proceduralIdle && clonedRoot?.traverse) {
          clonedRoot.traverse((node) => {

            // still restricted below to actual skeleton bones. Authored clips are

            const morphInfluences = node?.morphTargetInfluences;

              // names such as "happy" that may represent a full facial pose.

                const amplitude = Math.min(isSmileMorph ? 0.12 : 0.055, 1 - clampedBase);
                if (amplitude <= 0) continue;
                idleExpressionMorphTargets.push({
                  mesh: node,
                  index: morphIndex,
                  kind: isSmileMorph ? 'smile' : 'brow-raise',
                  baseInfluence: clampedBase,
                  amplitude
                });
              }

            // avoids accidentally animating broad facial poses or unrelated targets.
            if (morphDictionary && morphInfluences && typeof morphInfluences.length === 'number') {
              for (const [morphName, morphIndexValue] of Object.entries(morphDictionary)) {
                const normalizedMorphName = String(morphName || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
                const gazeMatch = /^(?:eye)?look(up|down|in|out)(left|right)$/.exec(normalizedMorphName);
                const morphIndex = Number(morphIndexValue);
                if (!gazeMatch || !Number.isInteger(morphIndex) || morphIndex < 0 || morphIndex >= morphInfluences.length) continue;
                const baseInfluence = Number(morphInfluences[morphIndex] || 0);
                if (!Number.isFinite(baseInfluence)) continue;
                const clampedBase = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, baseInfluence));
                const amplitude = Math.min(0.075, 1 - clampedBase);
                if (amplitude <= 0) continue;
                idleGazeMorphTargets.push({
                  mesh: node,
                  index: morphIndex,
                  direction: gazeMatch[1],
                  side: gazeMatch[2],
                  baseInfluence: clampedBase,
                  amplitude
                });
              }
            }
            // Discover only explicit jaw/mouth-open and standard viseme targets.
            // Jaw morphs take precedence; visemes are used only when no jaw target
            // exists on this staff member, avoiding double-driven mouth geometry.
            if (morphDictionary && morphInfluences && typeof morphInfluences.length === 'number') {
              for (const [morphName, morphIndexValue] of Object.entries(morphDictionary)) {
                const normalizedMorphName = String(morphName || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
                const isJawOpenMorph = /^(?:jawopen|mouthopen|mouthopening)$/.test(normalizedMorphName);
                const visemeMatch = /^(?:viseme)?(aa|oh|oo|ee|eh)$/.exec(normalizedMorphName);
                const morphIndex = Number(morphIndexValue);
                if ((!isJawOpenMorph && !visemeMatch) || !Number.isInteger(morphIndex)
                    || morphIndex < 0 || morphIndex >= morphInfluences.length) continue;
                const baseInfluence = Number(morphInfluences[morphIndex] || 0);
                if (!Number.isFinite(baseInfluence)) continue;
                const clampedBase = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, baseInfluence));
                const amplitude = Math.min(isJawOpenMorph ? 0.19 : 0.14, 1 - clampedBase);
                if (amplitude <= 0) continue;
                idleSpeechMorphTargets.push({
                  mesh: node,
                  index: morphIndex,
                  kind: isJawOpenMorph ? 'jaw' : 'viseme',
                  viseme: visemeMatch?.[1] || null,
                  baseInfluence: clampedBase,
                  amplitude
                });
              }
            }
            if (!node?.isBone || !node.quaternion?.clone) return;
            const boneName = String(node.name || '').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]/g, '');
            let channelSpecs = null;
            if (/^(?:mixamorig)?head$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [
                { axis: [0, 1, 0], amplitude: 0.026, speed: 0.42, phase: 0 },
                { axis: [1, 0, 0], amplitude: 0.011, speed: 0.31, phase: 1.1 },
                // Occasional, low-amplitude attention glance; deliberately slower
                // than the continuous idle channel so staff do not look restless.
                { axis: [0, 1, 0], amplitude: 0.018, speed: 0.15, phase: 1.7, pattern: 'attention-glance' },
                // A brief listening nod every ~15 seconds, with the neck sharing
                // a smaller counter-rotation to keep the movement natural.
                { axis: [1, 0, 0], amplitude: 0.010, period: 15, phase: 0, pattern: 'attention-nod' }
              ];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?neck[0-9]*$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [
                { axis: [0, 1, 0], amplitude: 0.013, speed: 0.37, phase: 0.55 },
                { axis: [1, 0, 0], amplitude: -0.0045, period: 15, phase: 0, pattern: 'attention-counter-nod' }
              ];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?(?:spine[0-9]*|chest|upperchest)$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 0, 1], amplitude: 0.005, speed: 0.68, phase: 1.45 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?(?:left|right)shoulder$/.test(boneName) || /^(?:mixamorig)?shoulder[lr]$/.test(boneName)) {
              const isRight = /right|shoulderr$/.test(boneName);
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 0, 1], amplitude: isRight ? -0.0035 : 0.0035, speed: 0.82, phase: 2.05 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?leftarm$|^upperarml$|^upperarmleft$/.test(boneName)) {
              // Upper-arm micro motion is deliberately tiny and mirrored for a relaxed stance.
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 0, 1], amplitude: 0.012, speed: 0.53, phase: 2.0 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?rightarm$|^upperarmr$|^upperarmright$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 0, 1], amplitude: -0.012, speed: 0.53, phase: 2.0 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?leftforearm$|^(?:mixamorig)?leftlowerarm$|^forearml$|^lowerarml$|^forearmleft$|^lowerarmleft$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [1, 0, 0], amplitude: 0.009, speed: 0.71, phase: 2.65 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?rightforearm$|^(?:mixamorig)?rightlowerarm$|^forearmr$|^lowerarmr$|^forearmright$|^lowerarmright$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [1, 0, 0], amplitude: -0.009, speed: 0.71, phase: 2.65 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?lefthand$|^handl$|^handleft$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 1, 0], amplitude: 0.006, speed: 0.64, phase: 0.9 }];
            } else if (/^(?:mixamorig)?righthand$|^handr$|^handright$/.test(boneName)) {
              channelSpecs = [{ axis: [0, 1, 0], amplitude: -0.006, speed: 0.64, phase: 0.9 }];
            }
            if (!channelSpecs) return;
            idleBoneTargets.push({
              bone: node,
              motionType: channelSpecs.some((spec) => String(spec.pattern || '').startsWith('attention-'))
                ? 'attention'
                : /arm|forearm|lowerarm|hand/.test(boneName) ? 'micro-gesture' : 'posture',
              baseQuaternion: node.quaternion.clone(),
              channels: channelSpecs.map((spec) => ({
                axis: new T.Vector3(spec.axis[0], spec.axis[1], spec.axis[2]),
                amplitude: spec.amplitude,
                speed: spec.speed,
                period: spec.period || 0,
                pattern: spec.pattern || 'sine',
                phase: spec.phase,
                deltaQuaternion: new T.Quaternion()
              }))
            });
          });
        }
        if (proceduralIdle) {
          proceduralIdleMode = idleBoneTargets.length ? 'articulated-bone-idle' : 'root-idle-fallback';
          proceduralIdleControllers.push({
            wrapper,
            baseRotationY: wrapper.rotation.y,
            baseRotationZ: wrapper.rotation.z,
            basePositionY: wrapper.position.y,
            boneTargets: idleBoneTargets,
            blinkMorphTargets: idleBlinkMorphTargets,
            blinkPeriod: 3.6 + ((replacements.length * 0.71) % 1.8),
            blinkPhase: (replacements.length * 1.31) % 2.4,
            expressionMorphTargets: idleExpressionMorphTargets,
            expressionPeriod: 11 + ((replacements.length * 0.97) % 7),
            expressionPhase: (replacements.length * 1.77) % 5,
            gazeMorphTargets: idleGazeMorphTargets,
            gazePeriod: 8.5 + ((replacements.length * 1.37) % 4.5),
            gazePhase: (replacements.length * 1.61) % 4,
            assetId: selected.asset.id,
            speechMorphTargets: idleSpeechMorphTargets,
            speechUsesVisemes: !idleSpeechMorphTargets.some((target) => target.kind === 'jaw'),
            speaking: false,
            speechIntensity: 0.68,
            speechWeight: 0,
            speechPhase: (replacements.length * 2.13) % 6,
            elapsed: 0,
            updateAccumulator: (replacements.length % 4) * (1 / proceduralIdleUpdateHz / 4),
            visibilityAccumulator: 0,
            visibleInScene: true,
            phase: (replacements.length * 0.83) % (Math.PI * 2)
          });
        }
    
        let mixer = null;
        if (clip) {
          mixer = new T.AnimationMixer(clonedRoot);
          mixer.clipAction(clip).reset().play();
          mixers.push(mixer);
        }
    
        person.root.visible = false;
        if (person.shadow) person.shadow.visible = false;
        replacements.push({ wrapper, mixer, person, assetId: selected.asset.id, clipName: clip?.name || null, renderMode: selectedRenderMode, animationActive: Boolean(clip), proceduralIdle: !clip && ['skinned-static-pose', 'static-mesh'].includes(selectedRenderMode), proceduralIdleMode, proceduralIdleGestureTargets: idleBoneTargets.filter((target) => target.motionType === 'micro-gesture').length, proceduralIdleAttentionTargets: idleBoneTargets.filter((target) => target.motionType === 'attention').length, proceduralIdleBlinkTargets: idleBlinkMorphTargets.length, proceduralIdleExpressionTargets: idleExpressionMorphTargets.length, proceduralIdleGazeTargets: idleGazeMorphTargets.length, proceduralIdleSpeechTargets: idleSpeechMorphTargets.length });
      }
    
      return {
        status: {
          loaded: replacements.length,
          fallback: Math.max(0, staff.length - replacements.length),
          mode: replacements.length ? 'approved-glb-staff-with-local-fallback' : 'merged-articulated-local-staff',
            assetsInUse: [...new Set(replacements.map((entry) => entry.assetId))],
            staticPosePlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => ['skinned-static-pose', 'static-mesh'].includes(entry.renderMode)).length,
            animatedPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => String(entry.renderMode || '').startsWith('animated-')).length,
            proceduralIdlePlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdle).length,
            articulatedIdlePlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleMode === 'articulated-bone-idle').length,
            rootIdleFallbackPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleMode === 'root-idle-fallback').length,
            microGestureStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleGestureTargets > 0).length,
            microGestureBoneTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleGestureTargets || 0), 0),
            attentionGestureStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleAttentionTargets > 0).length,
            attentionGestureBoneTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleAttentionTargets || 0), 0),
            blinkMorphStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleBlinkTargets > 0).length,
            blinkMorphTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleBlinkTargets || 0), 0),
            expressionMorphStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleExpressionTargets > 0).length,
            expressionMorphTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleExpressionTargets || 0), 0),
            eyeGazeMorphStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleGazeTargets > 0).length,
            eyeGazeMorphTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleGazeTargets || 0), 0),
            speechMorphStaffPlaced: replacements.filter((entry) => entry.proceduralIdleSpeechTargets > 0).length,
            speechMorphTargets: replacements.reduce((sum, entry) => sum + (entry.proceduralIdleSpeechTargets || 0), 0),

            idleVisibilityCacheMs: 250,
            idleUpdateTier: tier,
            idleVisibilityAware: true,
          approvedCandidates: candidates.length,
          compatibleModels: loadedModels.size,
          rejected
        },
        update(delta) {
          const step = Math.max(0, Math.min(Number(delta) || 0, 0.05));
          for (const mixer of mixers) mixer.update(step);
          // Static-pose staff do not need a bone pose recalculation on every render
          // frame. Keep the idle layer at 30 Hz and pause it when the tab or any
          // ancestor of the staff wrapper is hidden.
          if (typeof document === 'undefined' || !document.hidden) {
            for (const idle of proceduralIdleControllers) {
              // Refresh ancestor visibility at 4 Hz; hierarchy traversal is not needed
              // on every render frame. A hidden tab still pauses the entire idle layer.
              idle.visibilityAccumulator -= step;
              if (idle.visibilityAccumulator <= 0) {
                let visibleInScene = true;
                for (let node = idle.wrapper; node; node = node.parent) {
                  if (node.visible === false) { visibleInScene = false; break; }
                }
                idle.visibleInScene = visibleInScene;
                idle.visibilityAccumulator = proceduralIdleVisibilityInterval;
              }
              if (!idle.visibleInScene) continue;
              idle.updateAccumulator += step;
              const idleInterval = 1 / proceduralIdleUpdateHz;
              if (idle.updateAccumulator < idleInterval) continue;
              const idleStep = Math.min(idle.updateAccumulator, 0.1);
              idle.updateAccumulator = Math.max(0, idle.updateAccumulator - idleInterval);
              idle.elapsed += idleStep;
              const breath = Math.sin(idle.elapsed * 1.15 + idle.phase);
              const sway = Math.sin(idle.elapsed * 0.72 + idle.phase);
              // Short smooth eyelid pulses vary by character so staff do not blink
              // in sync. Static-pose models only are eligible for this controller.
              if (idle.blinkMorphTargets?.length) {
                const blinkCycle = ((idle.elapsed + idle.blinkPhase) % idle.blinkPeriod) / idle.blinkPeriod;
                const blinkWindow = 0.055;
                const blinkWeight = blinkCycle < blinkWindow
                  ? Math.sin(Math.PI * blinkCycle / blinkWindow)
                  : 0;
                for (const target of idle.blinkMorphTargets) {
                  const influences = target.mesh?.morphTargetInfluences;
                  if (!influences || target.index >= influences.length) continue;
                  influences[target.index] = target.baseInfluence + (1 - target.baseInfluence) * blinkWeight;
                }
              }
              // A brief, infrequent conversational micro-expression uses only
              // facial morphs already authored in the GLB. The envelope has smooth
              // rise/hold/release phases and a per-staff offset to avoid synchrony.
              if (idle.expressionMorphTargets?.length) {
                const expressionCycle = ((idle.elapsed + idle.expressionPhase) % idle.expressionPeriod) / idle.expressionPeriod;
                let expressionWeight = 0;
                if (expressionCycle >= 0.18 && expressionCycle < 0.27) {
                  const t = (expressionCycle - 0.18) / 0.09;
                  expressionWeight = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
                } else if (expressionCycle >= 0.27 && expressionCycle < 0.43) {
                  expressionWeight = 1;
                } else if (expressionCycle >= 0.43 && expressionCycle < 0.55) {
                  const t = 1 - (expressionCycle - 0.43) / 0.12;
                  expressionWeight = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
                }
                for (const target of idle.expressionMorphTargets) {
                  const influences = target.mesh?.morphTargetInfluences;
                  if (!influences || target.index >= influences.length) continue;
                  influences[target.index] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, target.baseInfluence + target.amplitude * expressionWeight));
                }
              }
              // A short, occasional glance uses only compatible eye-look morphs
              // already authored in the model. Most of each cycle remains centred.
              if (idle.gazeMorphTargets?.length) {
                const gazeElapsed = idle.elapsed + idle.gazePhase;
                const gazeCycle = (gazeElapsed % idle.gazePeriod) / idle.gazePeriod;
                let gazeWeight = 0;
                if (gazeCycle >= 0.61 && gazeCycle < 0.68) {
                  const t = (gazeCycle - 0.61) / 0.07;
                  gazeWeight = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
                } else if (gazeCycle >= 0.68 && gazeCycle < 0.77) {
                  gazeWeight = 1;
                } else if (gazeCycle >= 0.77 && gazeCycle < 0.84) {
                  const t = 1 - (gazeCycle - 0.77) / 0.07;
                  gazeWeight = t * t * (3 - 2 * t);
                }
                const gazeDirections = ['up', 'left', 'right', 'down'];
                const gazeDirection = gazeDirections[Math.floor(gazeElapsed / idle.gazePeriod) % gazeDirections.length];
                for (const target of idle.gazeMorphTargets) {
                  const influences = target.mesh?.morphTargetInfluences;
                  if (!influences || target.index >= influences.length) continue;
                  const activeDirection = gazeDirection === target.direction
                    || (gazeDirection === 'left' && ((target.side === 'left' && target.direction === 'out') || (target.side === 'right' && target.direction === 'in')))
                    || (gazeDirection === 'right' && ((target.side === 'left' && target.direction === 'in') || (target.side === 'right' && target.direction === 'out')));
                  const weight = activeDirection ? gazeWeight : 0;
                  influences[target.index] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, target.baseInfluence + target.amplitude * weight));
                }
              }
              // Live call systems can drive this controller with the
              // calloria:staff-speaking event. The mouth envelope eases in/out and
              // runs at the existing tier-aware idle cadence.
              if (idle.speechMorphTargets?.length) {
                const speechTarget = idle.speaking ? 1 : 0;
                const speechEase = 1 - Math.exp(-Math.max(0, idleStep) * 13);
                idle.speechWeight += (speechTarget - idle.speechWeight) * speechEase;
                if (idle.speechWeight < 0.001 && !idle.speaking) idle.speechWeight = 0;
                const syllablePulse = 0.18 + 0.82 * Math.abs(Math.sin(idle.elapsed * 8.4 + idle.speechPhase));
                const speechPulse = syllablePulse * idle.speechWeight * idle.speechIntensity;
                const visemeSequence = ['aa', 'oh', 'ee'];
                const activeViseme = visemeSequence[Math.floor((idle.elapsed * 1.8 + idle.speechPhase) % visemeSequence.length)];
                for (const target of idle.speechMorphTargets) {
                  const influences = target.mesh?.morphTargetInfluences;
                  if (!influences || target.index >= influences.length) continue;
                  const activeTarget = target.kind === 'jaw'
                    ? true
                    : idle.speechUsesVisemes && target.viseme === activeViseme;
                  const speechInfluence = activeTarget ? target.amplitude * speechPulse : 0;
                  influences[target.index] = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, target.baseInfluence + speechInfluence));
                }
              }
              if (idle.boneTargets?.length) {
                for (const target of idle.boneTargets) {
                  target.bone.quaternion.copy(target.baseQuaternion);
                  for (const channel of target.channels) {
                    let angle;
                    if (channel.pattern === 'attention-nod' || channel.pattern === 'attention-counter-nod') {
                      const period = Math.max(8, channel.period || 15);
                      const cyclePosition = ((idle.elapsed + idle.phase * 1.7) % period) / period;
                      const nodWindow = 0.12;
                      const nodPulse = cyclePosition < nodWindow
                        ? Math.sin(Math.PI * cyclePosition / nodWindow)
                        : 0;
                      angle = nodPulse * channel.amplitude;
                    } else {
                      const phase = idle.elapsed * channel.speed + idle.phase + channel.phase;
                      angle = Math.sin(phase) * channel.amplitude;
                    }
                    channel.deltaQuaternion.setFromAxisAngle(channel.axis, angle);
                    target.bone.quaternion.multiply(channel.deltaQuaternion);
                  }
                }
              } else {
                // Static meshes or rigs without known bone names retain restrained root idle.
                idle.wrapper.rotation.y = idle.baseRotationY + sway * 0.006;
                idle.wrapper.rotation.z = idle.baseRotationZ + Math.sin(idle.elapsed * 0.55 + idle.phase) * 0.0025;
                idle.wrapper.position.y = idle.basePositionY + breath * 0.0025;
              }
            }
          }
        },
        dispose() {
          for (const entry of replacements) {
            entry.mixer?.stopAllAction?.();
            scene.remove(entry.wrapper);
            entry.person.root.visible = true;
            if (entry.person.shadow) entry.person.shadow.visible = true;
          }
          replacements.length = 0;
          mixers.length = 0;
          if (typeof window !== 'undefined' && window.removeEventListener) {
            window.removeEventListener('calloria:staff-speaking', handleCalloriaStaffSpeaking);
          }
          proceduralIdleControllers.length = 0;
          disposeSourceModels(loadedModels);
        }
      };
    }

        draw(ctx, width, height);
        const texture = new THREE.CanvasTexture(canvas);
        texture.colorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
        texture.anisotropy = Math.min(tierDefaults.anisotropy, renderer.capabilities.getMaxAnisotropy());
        textures.push(texture);
        return texture;
      }
    
      const floorTexture = makeCanvasTexture((ctx, w, h) => {
        ctx.fillStyle = '#aeb9b8'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, w, h);
        for (let y = 0; y < h; y += 64) {
          for (let x = 0; x < w; x += 64) {
            ctx.fillStyle = ((x + y) / 64) % 2 ? 'rgba(255,255,255,.08)' : 'rgba(33,56,62,.045)';
            ctx.fillRect(x + 1, y + 1, 62, 62);
          }
        }
        ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(42,62,68,.10)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
        for (let x = 0; x <= w; x += 64) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(x, 0); ctx.lineTo(x, h); ctx.stroke(); }
        for (let y = 0; y <= h; y += 64) { ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(0, y); ctx.lineTo(w, y); ctx.stroke(); }
      }, 512, 512);

      floorTexture.repeat.set(12, 10);

          const x = (i * 83) % w;

          ctx.strokeStyle = i % 4 === 0 ? 'rgba(55,31,17,.16)' : 'rgba(255,238,211,.16)';
          ctx.lineWidth = i % 5 === 0 ? 2 : 1;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.moveTo(x, y);
          ctx.bezierCurveTo(x + length * .22, y - 3, x + length * .72, y + 3, x + length, y);
          ctx.stroke();
        }
        for (let i = 0; i < 14; i++) {
          ctx.strokeStyle = 'rgba(75,44,24,.11)'; ctx.lineWidth = 2;
          ctx.beginPath();
          ctx.ellipse((i * 67) % w, (i * 91) % h, 10 + (i % 4) * 5, 3 + (i % 3), .08, 0, Math.PI * 2);
          ctx.stroke();
        }

      function addBox(parent, name, size, position, material, rotationY = 0, extraRotation = null) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(boxGeo, material);
        mesh.name = name;
        mesh.position.set(position[0], position[1], position[2]);
        mesh.scale.set(size[0], size[1], size[2]);
        mesh.rotation.y = rotationY;
        if (extraRotation) mesh.rotation.set(extraRotation[0], extraRotation[1], extraRotation[2]);
        mesh.castShadow = false; mesh.receiveShadow = false;
        parent.add(mesh);
        return mesh;
      }
      function addSphere(parent, name, position, scale, material, geometry = sphereGeo) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
        mesh.name = name; mesh.position.set(...position); mesh.scale.set(...scale);
        parent.add(mesh); return mesh;
      }
      function addCylinder(parent, name, position, scale, material, geometry = cylinderGeo, rotation = null) {
        const mesh = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
